blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.
blocks.zh: 本章论述大语言模型研究的中心再生产问题. LLM输出是概率性的,各模型和版本不同,可对下游统计结果产生重大影响. 本章区分了可复制性,可复制性,稳健性,并提出了基于结果分配的概率标准,而不是相同的产出. 它引入了标准化的即时脚本,测试编码器和解码器的模型内变异,并开发出错误结构分析,以判断模型哪里出错以及其错误是否一致. 本章使用三个数据集,表明测量选择可以逆转下游回归系数的标志. 现有的以设计为基础的带有金色标记的子样本的校正恢复了有效性,但以估计精度为代价。 该章的主要贡献是叠装的开量模型组合,在保持估计有效性的同时提高校正步骤的精度.

blocks.en: 5.1  RT: The Achilles’ Heel of Applied LLM Research
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 RT:应用LLM的阿喀琉斯脚跟 研究

blocks.en: Barrie et al. (2024) provide one of the most systematic problematizations of LLM research in the social sciences. One of their key concerns is replicability, and they identify two sources of error that affect it: within -model and across -model variation. They organize coding practices along two questions: whether exact replicability is possible, and whether the approach is robust and thus independent of the particular system used to produce it. 4 4 4 Barrie et al. (2024) define their second question as fragility of replication, or when replication is dependent on access to a particular model or system. We have changed the terminology and use robustness , but it captures that same idea. The classical “data and code” replication from King (1995) demands that results be regenerated exactly but it is fragile, as it requires the replicator to have the same computational environment as the original researcher. Benoit et al. (2016) develop a crowdsourced coding approach that, by contrast, is not exactly replicable (one cannot recruit the identical workers each time). Yet it is robust, as the aggregate annotations across different coders and platforms approximate expert judgment. On Barrie et al. ’s ( 2024 ) account, proprietary LLMs occupy an uncomfortable position: they are neither replicable nor robust. They are not replicable because their output cannot be regenerated exactly. They are not robust because a model version can be updated or simply cease to exist, so even the tool itself may become unavailable. And LLM results also vary significantly across different models and versions ( Walker and Timoneda, 2025 ; Timoneda, 2026a ) . Results, therefore, are too dependent on the particular tool used in the research.
blocks.zh: Barrie等人(2024年)是社会科学中LLM研究最系统的问题之一. 它们的主要关切之一是可复制性,它们找出了影响它的两种错误来源:在模型内和跨模型变异. 它们围绕两个问题组织编码做法:准确的可复制性是否可行,以及该方法是否有力,从而独立于生产该方法所使用的特定系统。 4 4 4 Barrie等人(2024年)将他们的第二个问题定义为复制的脆弱性,或者在复制取决于获得某一特定模型或系统的情况下。 我们改变了术语,使用了稳健性,但它捕捉到了同样的想法。 King(1995年)的古典“数据和代码”复制要求精确地重新产生结果,但它是脆弱的,因为它要求复制人拥有与原研究员相同的计算环境。 Benoit等人(2016年)开发了一种众包编码方法,相比之下,这种方法并不完全可以复制(人们不能每次招聘相同的工人). 然而,它很有力,因为不同编码器和平台的汇总说明接近专家的判断。 在Barrie等人(2024年)的账号上,专有的有限责任公司处于一种不舒服的地位:它们既不可以复制,也不健全。 它们不能复制,因为它们的输出不能完全再生成。 它们并不健全,因为一个模型版本可以更新或干脆不复存在,所以即使工具本身也可能变得无法使用. 不同模型和版本的LLM结果也有很大差异(Walker and Timoneda, 2025; Timoneda, 2026a ). 因此,结果过于依赖研究中使用的特定工具。

blocks.en: Barrie et al. (2024) document both error sources empirically. For within-model variation, they re-run the same labeling tasks with the same model over several months, and separately repeat a task many times and average the output. Both exhibit substantial variation, with important effects on downstream estimates and statistical significance. For across-model variation, they run the same task across different models and versions, again finding sizable differences in output. Making a strong case for transparent and auditable tools, Spirling (2023) advocates for open-weight models, as they provide the smallest within-model variation and allow for model versions to be saved and reused over time ( Barrie et al., 2024 ) . We agree with most of this careful and thoughtful diagnosis.
blocks.zh: Barrie等人(2024年)根据经验记录了两个错误来源。 对于模型内部的变异,他们用相同的模型在几个月内重新运行同样的标签任务,并单独重复一个任务多次,平均输出. 两者差异很大,对下游估计数和统计意义有重要影响。 对于跨模型变异,它们在不同模型和版本中执行同样的任务,再次发现输出的巨大差异. Spirling(2023年)大力主张采用透明和可审计的工具,主张采用开放式模型,因为这些模型提供了模型内最小的变异,并允许模型版本在一段时间内保存和再使用(Barrie等人,2024年)。 我们同意这种谨慎和深思熟虑的诊断。

blocks.en: We would only qualify one part of it: how the authors conceptualize and measure robustness . Barrie et al. (2024) contrast robust crowdsourcing with fragile LLMs by running both over repeated rounds across several months. Run-to-run variability is wider for the language models than for the human coders, except in the case of their locally installed, open-weight Llama implementation, which shows lower variation than the humans. However, this comparison leaves two issues open. First, the evidence points to open-weight models being more robust, and this is a finding the authors themselves highlight. But it also cuts against their own framing. If open-weight LLMs are more robust, then this might be less a general LLM issue, and more a proprietary versus open-weight one. The authors do recommend the use of open-weight models as the closest available option to replication. We take this a step further and make open-weight models central to the study, use, and improvement of LLMs in social science research.
blocks.zh: 作者如何构思和衡量稳健程度。 Barrie等人(2024年)将强有力的众包与脆弱的有限责任公司形成对比,在几个月内反复运行。 对语言模型而言,运行到运行的变异性比对人类编码器的变异性要大,除了它们的本地安装,开放重量的Llama执行时显示的变异性比人类低. 然而,这一比较留下了两个问题。 首先,证据表明开放量级模型更强健,这是作者自己强调的一个发现. 但是,它也削减 他们自己的框架。 如果开放量级有限责任公司更强健,那么,这可能不是一般的LLM问题,而是一个专有的而不是开放量级的问题。 作者确实建议使用开放式模型,作为可供复制的最近选择。 我们更进一步,使开放式模型成为研究、使用和改进社会科学研究中的法学硕士课程的核心。

blocks.en: Our second qualification is more conceptual. Barrie et al. ’s ( 2024 ) comparison is asymmetric. On the LLM side, they measure variation across several different models, but on the human side they measure it within a single pool of crowd workers — the pool they characterize as robust. This is an informative comparison, but a single pool will naturally show less variation than a set of distinct models. The apples-to-apples comparison would set multiple models against multiple pools of coders. We do not actually know whether the human side would look as stable if the comparison were built symmetrically. Would the variance be the same, lower, or higher if we re-ran the task each month with three fresh undergraduate or graduate research assistants? Or with assistants we trained ourselves rather than others working only from written instructions? Robustness requires us to ask which model and which human, and to match the sources of variation on each side before the comparison can carry the weight placed on it.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二个资格是概念性的。 Barrie等人(2024年)的比较不对称。 在LLM方面,它们测量几种不同模型的变异,但在人类方面,它们测量它在一个人群工人的单池中——他们所形容的池是坚固的. 这是一个信息性比较,但一个单一的集合会自然显示出比一组不同的模型少的差异. 苹果对苹果的比较将针对多个编码器集合设定多个模型. 我们实际上不知道,如果将比较对称地建立起来,人类方面是否会看起来稳定。 如果我们每个月有三名新的本科生或研究生研究助理重新承担这项任务,那么差异会是一样的、较低的还是更高的? 或者我们自己训练的助理 而不是只听从书面指示的人? 强健性要求我们询问哪个模型和哪个人类,在比较能够承载它所赋予的重量之前,要匹配每一边的变异源.

blocks.en: These qualifications point to a broader way of thinking about LLMs and the RT problem that we advance in this book. The point is less about the findings in Barrie et al. (2024) and more about how we frame them. When applying LLMs to research, we need to understand the different sources of variation in model outputs, and then address each with a standardized set of procedures and recommendations. Within-model variation is a problem of replicability, while across-model variation is one of robustness. For within-model variation, we start from the architectural reality that decoder models are not deterministic. Aggregated over repeated iterations, however, their outputs let researchers estimate whether a robust central tendency and a constrained variance exist for a given task and model.
blocks.zh: 这些资格说明对LLM和我们在本书中推进的RT问题有更广泛的思考方式. 重点不在于Barrie等人(2024年)的调查结论,而在于我们如何设定这些结论。 在将法学硕士应用于研究时,我们需要了解模型产出的不同变化来源,然后用一套标准化的程序和建议处理每个变化。 模型内变异是一个可复制性的问题,而跨模型变异则是一个强健性的问题. 对于模型内部的变异,我们从建筑现实开始,解码器模型不是决定性的. 然而,由于反复重复,其产出使研究人员能够估计某项任务和模式是否存在强有力的中心趋势和受限制的差异。

blocks.en: This is the logic of probabilistic RT, which we develop in Section 5.2: by using repeated sampling from a single model, we can recover a stable central tendency together with a defined measure of variation. For across-model variation, we extend the implementation guidelines set out in Section 4.11 as the BCH approach. More generally, we insist on the importance of ‘theory’, meaning the principles that link model architectures, tasks, outputs, and downstream results. More theoretical clarity goes a long way toward helping applied researchers produce work consistent with RT principles. For us, this involves developing strong expert-coded datasets, testing more than one model, using fine-tuned models for benchmarking, and reducing measurement and other biases in downstream estimates. In the rest of the chapter, we develop these ideas and introduce our solutions to the reproducibility problem. We begin with the shift toward probabilistic RT.
blocks.zh: 这就是概率RT的逻辑,我们在第5.2节中发展了这个逻辑:通过使用一个单一模型的重复采样,我们可以恢复一个稳定的中心趋势,同时确定变异的尺度. 对于跨模式的变异,我们扩展了第4.11节中规定的执行准则,作为《生物与健康分类》的方法。 更一般地说,我们坚持“理论”的重要性,即将模型结构、任务、产出和下游结果联系起来的原则。 理论上的更清晰有助于应用研究者按照RT原则开展工作。 对我们来说,这涉及开发强有力的专家编码数据集,测试一个以上的模型,使用经过微调的模型作为基准,并减少下游估计数中的计量和其他偏差。 在本章的其余部分,我们发展了这些想法,并提出了我们对可复制性问题的解决办法。 我们从向概率性RT转变开始。

blocks.en: 5.2  Thinking in Distributions: A Probabilistic Approach to RT
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 在分配中的思考:对RT的概率方法

blocks.en: At the heart of our approach is the idea that we can think of RT in probabilistic terms. LLM output is a distribution, not a fixed value. So any single run with the same model and prompt on an annotation task produces one draw from that distribution. We normally evaluate each draw with an F1 score, but that F1 score is itself a single draw from a distribution of possible scores. Thus, we run the same task multiple times to obtain a distribution of F1 scores rather than relying on any single run. In essence, our approach embraces and leverages the added uncertainty of LLMs to produce replicable and robust work. Failing that, it provides a useful diagnostic tool for RT failures.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的核心是,我们可以以概率论来思考RT。 LLM输出是一个分布,而不是固定值. 因此,任何使用同一型号的单机运行,并迅速完成一个注释任务,都会产生一个来自该分布的抽取. 我们通常用一个F1的分数来评分,但F1的分数本身就是从可能的分数分配中得出的单笔分数. 因此,我们多次执行同样的任务,以获得F1分数的分布,而不是依赖任何单次运行. 从本质上讲,我们的办法包括并利用有限责任管理办法增加的不确定性,以产生可复制的、强有力的工作。 如果做不到这一点,它为RT故障提供了一个有用的诊断工具。

blocks.en: Probabilistic RT applies to both encoders and decoders, but it does so in slightly different ways and for different reasons. Encoders pose a narrower set of RT problems as they are, under the right conditions, essentially deterministic. With seeds and the environment fixed, the same input will always produce the same output. However, as we saw in Chapter 3, performance is highly dependent on where we draw the train-test split, particularly in small or imbalanced training sets. A favorable split will overestimate model performance and an unfavorable one will underestimate it. This is why we use 10-fold cross-validation and repeat it 10 times, which provides a distribution of scores for more robust out-of-sample estimates. The point to notice is that 10-times repeated 10-fold cross-validation is already probabilistic RT.
blocks.zh: 概率RT既适用于编码器,也适用于解码器,但这样做的方式略有不同,原因也不同. 编码器在适当条件下造成一系列较为狭窄的RT问题,基本上是决定性的。 随着种子和环境的固定,相同的输入将永远产生相同的输出. 然而,正如我们在第3章中所看到的那样,性能高度取决于我们如何划分列车测试,特别是在小型或不平衡的训练装置中。 有利的分割会高估模型性能,而不好的分割会低估模型性能. 这就是为什么我们使用10倍的交叉验证并重复它10次,这为更强的模拟估计提供了分数分配. 需要注意的是,10次重复10倍的交叉验证已经是概率RT.

blocks.en: Decoders, by contrast, are probabilistic at inference so they will produce different outputs across model runs even if the input is the same. The variation is thus in the model, which complicates replicability. However, we argue that probabilistic generation also means there is a distribution of potential outputs, one that lets us distinguish consistent from anomalous results during replication. By running the model repeatedly on a fixed version and prompt, we can extract a distribution of potential F1 scores with a clear central tendency and spread. This is similar to the output we would get with 10-times repeated 10-fold cross-validation with encoder models. 5 5 5 Note that the source of the variation is different for encoders and decoders. For encoder models, cross-validation evaluates the sensitivity of the model to different samples of the data, while in decoder models, the data are fixed, and the variation in output stems from the probabilistic nature of inference. This problem is aggravated when using closed-weight models, where the researcher has little control over the setup and deployment environment. So the mechanics of encoders and decoders differ, but the principle is the same: extract a distribution of scores and report its center and spread. Note that this applies to the measurement step, not yet to the downstream bias step.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,解码器在推论上是概率性的,因此即使输入是相同的,它们也会在模型运行中产生不同的输出. 因此,这种变化出现在模型中,使可复制性复杂化。 然而,我们主张,概率生成也意味着潜在产出的分配,让我们在复制过程中区分一致和异常结果。 通过在固定版本上反复运行模型并迅速,我们可以提取出具有明显的中心倾向和分布的潜在F1分数的分布. 这类似于我们得到的输出 10次重复10倍 交叉验证与编码器模型。 5 5 注意变异源对编码器和解码器不同. 对于编码器模型,交叉验证评价模型对不同数据样本的敏感性,而在解码器模型中,数据是固定的,输出的变异源于推断的概率性. 在使用闭重模型时,这个问题就更加严重,因为研究者对设置和部署环境几乎没有控制。 所以编码器和解码器的力学不同,但原理是一样的:提取一个分数的分布,并报告它的中心和分布. 注意这适用于测量步骤,而不适用于下游偏差步骤。

blocks.en: Lower F1 run-to-run variance reflects stable aggregate performance. Yet stability can still mask diverging error structures. Lower item-label instability, where fewer observations change labels across runs, generally translates into more stable downstream betas. However, a small number of changing labels on high-leverage observations can still move downstream estimates. This is why we should analyze the distribution of downstream betas directly rather than simply assuming it is stable based on the F1 results alone.
blocks.zh: 较低的F1运行间差异反映了稳定的汇总性能. 然而,稳定仍然可以掩盖不同的错误结构。 较低的项目标签不稳定性,其中跨行的观测改变标签较少,一般转化为更稳定的下游β. 然而,少数在高杠杆观测上改变的标签仍然可以移动下游的估计. 这就是为什么我们应该直接分析下游β的分布,而不是简单地假设它仅基于F1结果是稳定的.

blocks.en: Stability, however, is not accuracy. A perfectly stable measure can be systematically biased, yielding a coefficient that is consistent yet wrong across runs. This is the problem that design-based supervised learning (DSL) addresses ( Egami et al., 2023 ) . Our probabilistic approach selects an ensemble of models that minimizes downstream variance and makes estimates stable . It does not make them unbiased, however. The best-performing model often yields a more accurate measure, but not reliably so since systematic bias can still appear. Bias correction remains necessary even after choosing the model ensemble. This is why DSL complements our approach ( Egami et al., 2023 ) . Probabilistic RT lowers the variance of downstream betas, and DSL then works with more stable inputs, which leads to narrower confidence intervals and fewer type-II errors, as we show in Section 5.6.
blocks.zh: 然而,稳定性并不准确。 一个完全稳定的衡量标准可能会有系统性的偏差,产生一个始终一致但却是错误的系数。 这是基于设计的监督学习(DSL)解决的问题(Egami等人,2023年)。 我们的概率法选择了一组模型,这些模型可以将下游差异最小化,使估计数保持稳定。 然而,它并没有使它们不带偏见。 业绩最好的模型往往能产生更准确的衡量标准,但并不可靠,因为系统偏见仍然可能出现。 即使选择了型号综艺节目,比亚斯校正仍有必要. 因此,DSL补充了我们的方法(Egami等人,2023年)。 概率 RT降低了下游β的差数,DSL随后以更稳定的输入进行工作,这导致信任间隔更窄,II型错误也更少,我们在第5.6节中表明了这一点.

blocks.en: 5.3  Prompt Design for RT
blocks.zh: 5.3 RT的快速设计

blocks.en: The prompt is another source of variation that exacerbates the reproducibility problem. Although Barrie et al. (2024) discuss prompt stability, they do not test it explicitly in their design. Small changes in wording can shift a model’s output (see Section 4.8). Researchers are neither expected nor accustomed to reporting every prompt they tried on the way to a result. This leaves the door open to both honest error and selective reporting ( Baumann et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 催化是另一个变异来源,加剧了可复制性问题. 虽然Barrie等人(2024年)讨论了迅速稳定的问题,但他们在设计中并没有明确地测试这个问题。 措辞上的细微变化可以改变模型的产出(见第4.8节)。 研究人员既不期望也不习惯于报告他们在取得结果的路上所尝试的每一个迅速。 这就为诚实错误和选择性报告敞开了大门(Baumann等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: In the spirit of Marvin et al. (2024) , we propose a standard scripted prompt that balances consistency with the elements that maximize performance. We combine this first suggestion with the rolling-window approach introduced in Section 4.8 ( Timoneda and Vallejo Vera, 2026 ) . By accumulating prior labeling decisions in the context, researchers can reduce the influence of any single phrasing choice. Also in Section 4.8, we test four factors that can leak variation into the model output: prompt length, specificity, order of categories, and specified role. We model our prompt script around these elements.
blocks.zh: 本着Marvin et al. (2024)的精神,我们提出一个标准脚本化的提示,以平衡与最大性能的元素的一致性. 我们把第一项建议与第4.8节(Timoneda和Vallejo Vera, 2026年)中提出的滚动窗口办法结合起来。 通过在上下文中积累先前的标签决定,研究人员可以减少任何单一措辞选择的影响. 同样在第4.8节中,我们测试了四个可以漏入模型输出的变异因素:即时长度,特异性,类别顺序,以及指定的角色. 我们围绕着这些元素来模拟我们迅速的脚本。

blocks.en: The script standardizes order and content. It includes the elements that prior research and our own testing have identified as producing greater variation in output. It is also transparent and lowers idiosyncratic content choices. At the beginning of the prompt, we suggest researchers clearly spell out the LLM’s role and a context for the task. Both narrow the space the model attends to, signaling which parts of the text, semantic or syntactic, it should prioritize for the task. 6 6 6 Research finds that varying the persona in the prompt has little effect on outcomes ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . We confirm this finding in Section 4.8. We standardize it nonetheless, to guard against unknown sources of variation in future models. While category definitions will vary by task and researcher, we recommend giving the model hints about which linguistic signals point toward a category (positive indicators) and which point away (negative indicators). We recommend positive and negative indicators because they make the boundaries of each category explicit (what falls inside a category and what does not), particularly in cases where two categories are hard to differentiate.
blocks.zh: 脚本将顺序和内容标准化. 它包括先前的研究和我们自己的测试确定在产出方面产生较大差异的要素。 它还具有透明度,并降低了对具体内容的选择。 我们建议研究者明确阐述LLM的作用和任务的背景。 两者都缩小了模型所覆盖的空间,表示文本的哪些部分,语义或合成部分,它应当为任务确定优先次序. 6 6 6 研究发现,即时人物的改变对结果影响不大(郑等人,2024年). 我们在第4.8节中确认了这一结论。 尽管如此,我们还是把它标准化,以防止未来模型中未知的变异源。 虽然类别定义将因任务和研究人员而异,但我们建议给出模型提示,说明语言信号指向一个类别(正指标)和指向哪个类别(负指标)。 我们建议采用积极和消极的指标,因为这些指标明确了每一类的界限(哪些属于一类,哪些不属于一类),特别是在两类很难区分的情况下。

blocks.en: To avoid useless answers from the model, and to allow for a cleaner tidying of the data after running the code, we specify the output format. Toward the end of the prompt, we include the examples (if carrying out few-shot learning), and the space for the context window (if carrying out a rolling window approach). While there is still space for discretionary decisions regarding the wording of the task, and the definition of the concepts, we believe that following a similar script reduces sources of variation that can affect outcomes and, eventually, replicability. When replicating approaches, it also provides a format in which it is easier to identify where prompting can be tested (e.g., randomization of categories, sample of examples) and improved.
blocks.zh: 为了避免模型中无用的答案,并允许在运行代码后对数据进行更清洁的清理,我们指定了输出格式. 在提示的末尾,我们包括实例(如果进行几拍学习)和上下文窗口的空间(如果进行滚动窗口方法)。 虽然在任务措辞和概念定义方面仍有自由裁量决定的余地,但我们认为,采用类似的文字将减少可能影响到结果和最终可复制性的变化来源。 在复制方法时,它也提供了一种格式,可以更容易地确定可在哪些地方进行提示测试(如类别随机化,实例样本)并改进.

blocks.en: 5.4  Replicability of Encoder and Decoder LLMs: Problem and Solutions
blocks.zh: 5.4 编码器和编码器的可复制性:问题和解决办法

blocks.en: 10-Times Repeated Cross-Validation for Encoder Models as an Approach to Replicability
blocks.zh: 10 次重复编码器模型的跨变异,作为复制方法

blocks.en: As previously discussed, models like BERT and RoBERTa are essentially deterministic at inference. For a classification-tuned encoder, inference is a fixed sequence of arithmetic operations. The initial input embedding gets multiplied through the frozen weight matrices, layer by layer, producing a set of logits from which we select the highest one as the predicted class (argmax). Since the input text and weight matrices are the same and all we extract is one set of logits, the computations are the same each time. This contrasts, of course, with decoder models, which probabilistically output different tokens in a sequence, yielding a potentially different combination of outputs each time. For now, let us focus on encoders.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,BERT和RoBERTA等模型在推论上基本上是决定性的。 对于分类调解编码器,推论是算术操作的固定序列. 初始输入嵌入通过冷冻重量矩阵逐层递增,生成一组对数,我们从中选择最高的一组作为预测类(argmax). 由于输入文本和权重矩阵是相同的,我们提取的只是一组对数,因此每次计算都是相同的. 当然,这与解码器模型形成对比,这些模型很可能会按顺序输出不同的符号,每次都会产生潜在的不同的输出组合. 现在,让我们专注于编码器。

blocks.en: We can interpret the determinism of encoders in two ways for replicability. First, we could argue in favor of fine-tuning the model once and freezing the train-validation-test split, which guarantees exact replication. A purist might prefer this, since it returns the same results each time. However, we think this approach has a key drawback. It relies on the observed model performance on one random data split being representative of the true out-of-sample model performance. As we saw in Chapter 3 and our discussion of ‘lucky folds’, the reality is that where you split the data affects the performance you observe.
blocks.zh: 我们可以用两种方式来解释编码器的确定性, 来解释可复制性。 首先,我们可以主张一次对模型进行微调,并冻结列车验证测试分拆,这保证了准确的复制. 纯洁主义者可能更喜欢这样,因为每次结果都是一样的。 然而,我们认为这种做法有一个关键的缺点。 它依赖于观测到的模型性能,一个随机数据分割是真实的模拟模型性能的代表. 正如我们在第三章和关于“幸运折叠”的讨论中所看到的那样,现实是,如果数据被分割,就会影响你观察到的绩效。

blocks.en: As we argued in Chapter 3, we recommend 10-times repeated 10-fold cross-validation for tasks like the ones in this book. With RoBERTa, fold-to-fold variance is small but not trivial, as one fold can score 0.81 and another 0.9. Taking any single fold as the result, even after setting a seed, risks overestimating or underestimating performance, unless one gets lucky, and those odds are not worth playing. Repeating 10-fold CV ten times yields a distribution of 100 different out-of-sample F1 scores, and its mean and standard deviation are the best approximation of true out-of-sample model performance.
blocks.zh: 正如我们在第三章中论证的那样,我们建议对本书中的任务重复10次10倍的交叉验证. 与RoBERTA相比,折叠对折差很小但并非微不足道,因为一个折叠可以得0.81分,另一个0.9. 将任何单折作为结果,即使在设定种子后,也有可能高估或低估性能,除非一个人得到幸运,这些概率并不值得玩. 重复10倍的CV十次产生100个不同样本的F1分数的分布,其平均值和标准偏差是真实样本外模型性能的最佳近似值.

blocks.en: How does this bear on replicability and robustness? Well, it may complicate replicability as we depart the comfortable, deterministic world of traditional replication. But repeated resampling, averaged over randomized draws, is precisely what we mean by probabilistic replicability. If a researcher ran 10-times repeated CV on the same task using RoBERTa, the mean and standard deviation across all 100 resulting runs should be almost identical to ours. A parallel way of thinking about this is that two researchers, using the same data, model, and hyperparameter choices, should produce practically the same distribution of F1 scores over 100 runs. To us, this is the approach that best balances the need to estimate a model’s true out-of-sample performance with the requirement that results be replicable.
blocks.zh: 这对可复制性和坚固性有何影响? 当我们离开一个舒适的、决定性强的传统复制世界时,它可能会使复制能力复杂化。 但重复复制,平均比随机化的图画, 正是我们所说的概率复制。 如果一个研究人员用RoBERTa重复了10次CV, 在所有100次运行中的平均偏差和标准偏差应该和我们的差不多。 与此平行的思考方法是,两位研究者使用相同的数据,模型和超参数选择,应该产生实际上相同的F1分数分布,超过100个运行. 对我们来说,这是在需要估计一个模型的真正模拟性能与要求结果可以复制之间达成最佳平衡的办法。

blocks.en: Within-Model Variation for Decoders
blocks.zh: 解码器模式内变化

blocks.en: Probabilistic replicability applies even more strongly to decoders, which are themselves probabilistic by nature. First, a note on scope: here we focus on within-model variation and thus replicability , not robustness, which is the larger, more problematic issue considering the wide array of available LLMs these days. We cover robustness in the next section. Here, we think of replicability as a within-model problem because any replication of an LLM-derived result occurs within a clear and confined model space. That is, when a researcher uses an LLM to produce work, they must disclose the model version, the exact prompt, and the hyperparameters set. This focuses the replication and limits the potential for mismatches. The questions inevitably become more about whether the researcher’s choices are correct, rather than untraceable variation in the model itself.
blocks.zh: 概率可复制性甚至更有力地适用于解码器,这些解码器本身本质上是概率性的. 首先,关于范围的说明:在这里,我们侧重于模型内的变化,因此是可复制的,而不是强健的,考虑到目前已有的各种有限责任公司,这是更大的、更成问题的问题。 我们将在下一节阐述稳健性。 在这里,我们认为可复制性是一个模型内的问题,因为任何LLM衍生结果的复制都发生在一个清晰和封闭的模型空间内。 也就是说,当研究人员使用LLM来制作作品时,他们必须披露模型版本,准确的即时,以及超参数集. 这突出复制的重点,限制错配的可能性. 研究者的选择是否正确,而不是模型本身的不可追踪的变化,这些问题不可避免地变得更加严重。

blocks.en: In practice, a decoder LLM often produces similar results across runs, especially at temperatures close to zero. We saw in our results in Section 4.6 that decoders are especially consistent across same-model runs. Gemma 4, for example, produced F1 scores of 0.5128, 0.5124 and 0.5144 for the political advertising task, and other models behave similarly. Results, then, should replicate consistently. Thus, in probabilistic replication, we are interested in the shape of the distribution, not in identical results. 7 7 7 For extra confidence, we can always increase the number of runs to generate distributions of means and standard deviations that converge across multiple runs. It requires that the distribution of performance, as measured through F1 scores, dispersion, and item-level disagreement, falls within a narrow, reportable band. We need to become comfortable with small differences across replications, provided we can attribute them to model randomness rather than model choice.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,一个解码器LLM经常产生类似的跨径结果,特别是在接近零的温度下. 我们在4.6节的结果中看到,解码器在同一种模式的运行中特别一致。 例如Gemma 4,为政治广告任务制作了0.5128,0.5124和0.5144的F1分,其他模特行为也相似. 因此,成果应始终如一地复制。 因此,在概率复制中,我们对分布的形态感兴趣,而不是相同的结果. 7 7 7 对于额外的置信度,我们总是可以增加运行次数,以生成手段分布和标准偏差,在多个运行中趋同. 它要求通过F1分数,分散度和项目层面的分歧来衡量的性能分布属于狭义,可报告的波段. 我们需要适应在复制过程中的细小差异,前提是我们可以把它们归结为模型随机性而不是模型选择.

blocks.en: Therefore, replicability with decoders is not inherently problematic. Researcher decisions, however, can be, especially around model choice and prompting strategy. Indeed, prompt design is one of the most important decisions affecting both performance and robustness. For replicability, prompting is not an inherent issue because it is held fixed, as we reuse the author’s exact prompt to replicate a full pipeline. So prompt variation is not central to replicability, but it is key for robustness, where we ask whether the result survives different prompt formulations.
blocks.zh: 因此,带有解码器的复制性在本质上并不成问题. 然而,研究人员可以作出决定,特别是围绕模式选择和激励战略作出决定。 事实上,迅速设计是影响业绩和稳健性的最重要决定之一。 就可复制性而言,催化不是一个固有的问题,因为它是固定的,因为我们重新利用作者确切的催化来复制一个完整的管道。 因此,迅速的变异并不是可复制性的核心,而是坚固性的关键,在这里,我们询问结果是否在不同的即时配方中存在。

blocks.en: A Guideline for Replicability of Work Using LLMs
blocks.zh: 使用LLMS复制工作准则

blocks.en: Our approach to replicability shifts the focus from obtaining the same output, to obtaining a similar distribution. For encoder models, researchers should report the pre-processing steps, random seeds, hyperparameters, software, models used (and from where and when they were downloaded), and complete code pipeline. Researchers should also release training data, fine-tuned models and tokenizers when appropriate. When implementing our suggested 10-times repeated CV approach, the averages of performance statistics and their standard deviations must be reported.
blocks.zh: 我们处理可复制性的方法将重点从获得相同的产出转向获得类似的分布。 对于编码器模型,研究人员应当报告预处理步骤,随机种子,超参数,软件,所使用的模型(以及从何处下载和何时下载),并完成代码管道. 研究人员还应酌情发布培训数据、微调模型和标注剂。 在执行我们建议的10次重复的简历办法时,必须报告业绩统计的平均值及其标准差。

blocks.en: For decoder models, researchers should report the exact model version, prompt, temperature and sampling settings, software, and date of access (if using an API). 8 8 8 We stress model exactness because most developers release many versions of the same model. For instance, OpenAI’s API includes models such as GPT-5.5, GPT-5.5-pro, GPT-5.5-chat-latest, and others — the ones with ‘latest’ silently update. Similarly, they should release the data and, where possible, the code. As with encoder models, researchers should run their tasks multiple times and report aggregate variation. The number of runs should be based on the degree of uncertainty observed.
blocks.zh: 对于解码器模型,研究人员应当报告精确的模型版本,即时,温度和采样设置,软件,以及访问日期(如果使用API). 8 8 8 我们强调模型精确性,因为大多数开发者发布了许多版本的同一模型. 例如OpenAI的API包括GPT-5.5、GPT-5.5-pro、GPT-5.5-chat-latest等模型, 同样,它们应该公布数据,并在可能的情况下公布代码。 同编码器模型一样,研究人员应多次执行任务,并报告总体变化情况。 运行次数应基于所观察到的不确定性程度。

blocks.en: We end by reiterating that a successful probabilistic replication does not require identical labels or identical distributions. It requires the replication estimates to fall within certain pre-specified margins of the original results, for instance within two standard deviations of the reported mean performance, and comparable bands for dispersion, item-level disagreement, and downstream coefficients.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们重申,成功的概率复制不需要相同的标签或相同的分发。 它要求复制估计值在原始结果预先确定的某些幅度内,例如,在所报告的平均业绩的两个标准差内,以及在分散、项目级分歧和下游系数方面的可比波段内。

blocks.en: 5.5  Robustness of Encoder and Decoder LLMs: Problem and Solutions
blocks.zh: 5.5 编码器和编码器LLMs的强性:问题和解决办法

blocks.en: While replicability is about generating an author’s exact results, robustness refers to the consistency of the findings across multiple LLMs. A study is robust if performance and downstream results hold when deploying different models. For Transformer LLMs, the question inevitably arises: if models are probabilistic in nature, many different models exist, and none is fully transparent about how they are trained, 9 9 9 The only notable exception is AI2’s OLMo family of models ( Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) . then how can research that actively uses LLMs be robust at all? Barrie et al. (2024) , among others, raise exactly this valid point.
blocks.zh: 虽然可复制性涉及产生作者的准确结果,但稳健性是指多个法学硕士的研究结果的一致性。 如果应用不同模型时能保持业绩和下游结果,则一项研究是强有力的。 对变形器LLMS来说,问题不可避免地产生:如果模型在性质上是概率性的,那么就存在许多不同的模型,而且对于如何训练这些模型,没有一个完全透明,9 9 9 唯一显著的例外是AI2的OLMo模型家族(Groeneveld等人,2024年). 那么,积极使用LLMs的研究如何才能强大起来? Barrie等人(2024年)等都提出了这个正确的观点。

blocks.en: We understand and share the spirit of the critique and have sought to reframe the debate slightly in a more positive direction in the introduction to this chapter. Here, we want to provide specific solutions for the core issues leveraging the benchmark-compare-harmonize (BCH) approach, which we think provides clear answers for the key issues in the general reproducibility debate. The first issue is the across-model problem, to which we turn now.
blocks.zh: 我们理解并赞同这些批评的精神,并力求在本章导言中略微从更积极的方向重新界定辩论。 在此,我们希望为核心问题提供具体的解决办法,利用基准-比较-协调(BCH)办法,我们认为,这种办法为一般可复制性辩论中的关键问题提供了明确答案。 第一个问题是跨模式问题,我们现在要讨论这个问题。

blocks.en: The Across-Model Problem
blocks.zh: 跨模式问题

blocks.en: As we discussed earlier, decoder LLMs are constantly developed, introduced, deprecated and eliminated. This certainly affects replicability, as we need to be able to access models to replicate work, but it also introduces problems for robustness. The main one is that many models exist and rapidly change, so which results should we trust? Can we even trust any results at all, in this context?
blocks.zh: 正如我们先前所讨论的那样,解码器LLM是不断发展、引入、贬值和淘汰的。 这当然会影响复制能力,因为我们需要能够利用模型复制工作,但它也带来了强健性的问题。 主要的一点是,许多模式是存在的,而且正在迅速变化,因此我们应该相信哪些结果? 在这方面,我们甚至能够相信任何结果吗?

blocks.en: We think there is a general need for both theoretical and applied direction when selecting LLMs. We like making the parallel to statistical inference: we know that, for certain types of data structures, a certain model is more appropriate than another one. If we have survival data, well, a simple OLS regression may not suffice. Or if we have TSCS data with a binary dependent variable, OLS might work great sometimes but logistic regression may generally be more appropriate. Here, while the nexus between LLMs and data is more diffuse, we think it still matters.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,在选择法学硕士时,一般需要理论和应用方向。 我们喜欢与统计推论平行:我们知道,对于某些类型的数据结构,某种模型比另一种模型更合适。 如果我们有生存数据,那么,简单的OLS回归可能是不够的. 或者如果我们有带有二进制依赖变量的TSCS数据,OLS有时可能会大有效果,但物流回归一般可能更合适. 在这里,虽然法学硕士和数据之间的联系比较分散,但我们认为仍然很重要。

blocks.en: As we have argued, encoders still work quite well in annotation tasks with shorter texts and complex categories, and in topic modeling to cluster documents. Decoders, on the other hand, generally fall short on annotation tasks and need QLoRA fine-tuning to approach or improve on encoder performance. Decoders, however, complement encoders on several of these tasks. They can label and interpret the output of topic models, and they enable flexible semi-supervised variants of them (Section 4.7). For encoders, model choice is straightforward and we recommend RoBERTa, which more consistently outperforms other encoders in classification tasks in extant testing. As Chapter 3 discussed, domain-specific and multilingual encoders suit particular tasks, but RoBERTa remains the practical default.
blocks.zh: 正如我们所指出,编码器在缩短文本和复杂类别的说明任务方面,以及在为分组文件制作模型的专题方面,仍然非常有效。 另一方面,解码器一般没有完成注释任务,需要QLORA微调以接近或改进编码器性能. 然而,解码器补充了其中几项任务的编码器. 它们可以对主题模型的输出进行标签和解释,并且能够使其具有灵活的半监督变体(第4.7节). 对于编码器来说,模型的选择是直截了当的,我们推荐RoBERTa,它比其他编码器在现成测试中的分类任务中表现得更一致. 正如第3章所讨论的,特定域和多语种编码器适合特定的任务,但RoBERTa仍然是实际的默认.

blocks.en: As for decoders, the situation is more complex. We favor open-weight models for their increased transparency and ease of fine-tuning, so that narrows the scope already. Among these, smaller models with ≤ \leq 9 billion parameters tend to perform admirably well but still fall short on some tasks, having less general pattern knowledge and weaker reasoning. Small but more capable models in the 20–40B range often offer the best of both worlds, with strong performance at a reasonable cost. Chapter 4’s testing confirms this with Gemma, Llama and Mistral, but performance remains task-specific. Medium and large models, 70B or above, tend to be difficult and expensive to deploy locally, and their increased reasoning capacities often do not translate into task-specific performance gains — we saw this in Section 4.6. This, of course, is the state of the art as of this writing, and it will likely have changed by the time the book is in the reader’s hands. Yet the main takeaway is the relative standing of the models, which ultimately affects performance and choice.
blocks.zh: 至于解码器,情况更为复杂. 我们赞成开放加权模式,以提高透明度和方便微调,从而缩小范围。 其中,拥有 \\leq 90 亿参数的小型模型往往表现良好,但在某些任务上仍然不足,一般模式知识较少,推理能力较弱. 20–40B范围内的小型但能力更强的模型往往能提供两个世界中最好的,并以合理的成本提供强大的性能. Gemma、Llama和Mistral的测试证实了这一点, 70B或以上的中型和大型模型往往难以在当地部署,而且费用高昂,而且它们增加的推理能力往往没有转化为具体任务的业绩收益——我们在第4.6节中看到了这一点。 这当然是写作时的艺术状态, 然而主要外卖是模型的相对地位,这最终会影响性能和选择.

blocks.en: The question for robustness is how to know whether results survive model choice when we generate data with LLMs and report downstream estimates. For this, we return to Section 4.11 and its main recommendation to benchmark, compare, and harmonize. The procedure is as follows. We (1) use RoBERTa as the encoder benchmark, (2) run an ensemble of open-weight models with few-shot CoT, (3) apply QLoRA fine-tuning to the best performer for a second benchmark, (4) produce downstream estimates across models to approximate the variation in resulting betas, and (5) apply DSL to correct any remaining biases from LLM labels. Steps (1) through (3) concern measurement and how to maximize the quality of the labels, while steps (4) and (5) concern downstream inference. We approach each in turn. The following subsections develop the measurement steps: how to select the best-performing model and the ensemble (the maximization problem), and how to read the structure of errors across models, meaning when and where in the data the model errs, not just how often. We develop the downstream steps in Section 5.8.
blocks.zh: 稳健性的问题是,当我们用LLMs生成数据并报告下游估计数时,如何知道结果是否在模型选择中存活. 为此,我们回到第4.11节及其关于基准、比较和协调的主要建议。 程序如下。 我们 (1) 使用 RoBERTa 作为编码器基准, (2) 运行一个带几发 CoT 的开放式模型组合, (3) 将 QLORA 微调用于第二个基准的最佳表现者, (4) 得出不同模型的下游估计,以大致显示结果的β的变异,(5) 应用 DSL 来纠正 LLM 标签中的任何剩余偏差. 步骤(1)至(3)涉及测量以及如何尽量提高标签的质量,步骤(4)和(5)则涉及下游推论。 我们逐个接近。 以下各小节发展了测量步骤: 如何选择最佳的模型和综艺(最大化问题),以及如何读取跨模型的错误结构,意思是模型在数据中发生错误的时间和地点,而不只是频率. 我们开发了5.8节的下游步骤。

blocks.en: The Maximization Game: Selecting the Best-Performing Model for Measurement
blocks.zh: 最大化游戏:选择衡量的最佳模式

blocks.en: Measurement is a maximization problem. As researchers, we always seek the best possible measure of a concept, and we may now want to build it from a text source using an LLM. For that, the goal is to maximize the performance of an LLM for a particular task, minimizing the measurement bias it induces. However, performance maximization is not how we traditionally approach RT, and in some ways it seems to be anathema to it. We have always focused more on the stability and ‘truth’ of a result rather than on obtaining the best result. Yet measurement has always been a maximization exercise: the best coders, the best codebooks, and the best practices to ensure the variable that results from human-coded text is as accurate as possible. This should certainly not be different with LLMs, and we should ensure we get the most accurate annotations or topics from these models. The question, then, is how to generate the best data for downstream analysis with LLMs, just as we have long done with human coders. To us, the key to this maximization problem is to have clear guidelines for what is good measurement with LLMs and what is not. This is what we propose here.
blocks.zh: 测量是一个最大化的问题。 作为研究者,我们总是寻求一个概念的最佳尺度,现在我们也许想用LLM从文本来源建立它. 为此,目标是最大限度地提高特定任务的LLM的性能,尽量减少它带来的测量偏差。 然而,发挥最大性能并不是我们传统上对待RT的方式,在某些方面似乎令它厌恶。 我们始终更注重结果的稳定性和 " 真实性 " ,而不是取得最佳结果。 然而,衡量一直是一项最大化的工作:最好的编码器、最好的编码簿以及确保人类编码文本所产生的变量尽可能准确的最佳做法。 这当然与法学硕士无关,我们应确保从这些模型中获得最准确的说明或专题。 因此,问题是如何产生最好的数据, 与LLMS一起进行下游分析, 就像我们长期以来对人类编码器所做的那样。 对我们来说,这一最大化问题的关键是制定明确的准则,说明如何用有限责任管理办法进行良好的衡量,哪些不是。 这是我们在这里提出的。

blocks.en: First, maximization in measurement requires a gold-standard, high-quality and theoretically grounded training and/or validation set ( Dávila Gordillo et al., 2026 ) . As stated throughout the book, the final measure of a concept is only as good as the definition of that concept and its identification in the data. The maximization game becomes a test of which model best executes the task, judged against the human-coded sample. Second, and as we have argued throughout, researchers should prioritize open-weight models for transparency and the ability to save and re-run exact versions ( Spirling, 2023 ; Barrie et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 首先,测量的最大化需要一套黄金标准、高质量和有理论依据的培训和/或验证(Dávila Gordillo等人,2026年)。 如整本书所述,一个概念的最后衡量标准只能与该概念的定义及其在数据中的识别一样好。 最大化游戏变成了一个测试,根据人类编码样本判断,模型最能执行任务. 第二,正如我们一直主张的那样,研究人员应优先考虑开放量级模型,以提高透明度以及保存和重新运行准确版本的能力(Spirling,2023年;Barrie等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Third, we should maximize classifier performance using an ensemble of LLMs, as the BCH approach proposes. Three points warrant further elaboration. First, the encoder benchmark is not only inexpensive and deterministic, but it also still beats state-of-the-art decoders in many applied tasks. 10 10 10 If a minimally fine-tuned encoder already matches or beats powerful decoder models, that is a useful signal: further gains are more likely to come from improving separability in the codebook and training data than from switching models. At that point, therefore, the researcher can either (1) expand the labeled set to further fine-tune RoBERTa or the best-performing decoder with QLoRA; or (2) if performance is already acceptable, use the encoder to label the remaining data. Second, the ensemble of open-weight models should span developers and sizes. At the time of writing, strong options are Gemma 4 31B, Llama 4 Maverick, and Mistral 3.2 24B, all with few-shot CoT. 11 11 11 Depending on computational resources and access, which we have shown are not as problematic a barrier as they once were, researchers can use the smaller 7B and 8B equivalents, if necessary. Third, QLoRA fine-tuning of the best-performing open-weight decoder can improve performance significantly ( Halterman and Keith, 2025 ) , although gains are task-specific (see Section 4.9). Researchers with remaining funding can add the latest proprietary model from OpenAI, Anthropic or Google as a final comparison point.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们应当按照《生物与健康分类办法》的建议,使用一系列的LLMS来最大限度地分类。 三点值得进一步阐述。 首先,编码器基准不仅成本低廉且具有决定性,而且在许多应用任务中仍然比最先进的解码器要好. 10 10 如果一个微调的编码器已经匹配或击败了强大的解码器模型,那就是一个有用的信号: 与切换模型相比,提高编码本和培训数据的可分离性更有可能带来更多的收益. 因此,此时,研究者可以 (1) 扩展标签集,以进一步微调RoBERTa或与QLORA进行最佳性能的解码器;或者 (2) 如果性能已经可以接受,使用编码器对剩余数据进行标签. 第二,开放量级模型的组合应覆盖开发者和规模。 在编写本报告时,强选项是Gemma 4 31B,Llama 4 Maverick,和Mistral 3.2 24B,都只有很少的镜头 CoT 11 11 取决于计算资源和访问,我们已经表明,它们并不像以前那样有问题,必要时研究人员可以使用较小的7B和8B等效. 第三,QLORA对表现最好的开放量级解码器进行微调,可以显著改善性能(Harterman and Keith, 2025),虽然收益是特定任务(见第4.9节). 拥有剩余资金的研究人员可以添加来自OpenAI,Anthropic或Google的最新专有模式作为最后的比较点.

blocks.en: Now, we understand that this multi-model approach may increase costs, but in our experience these costs remain quite manageable when using open-weight models. 12 12 12 If one has access to an institutional GPU, then the researcher has little to no costs. Otherwise, costs are either from GPU rentals, which often range between 0.5 and 1.5 dollars per hour for the models and tasks tested in this book, or from the DeepInfra (or similar) API, which charges very small sums per token for open-weight models. QLoRA fine-tuning requires a GPU in any case. There is also a clear reasoning behind it: as our results in Section 4.6 showed, performance may differ across models and tasks, and the patterns are not entirely clear. 13 13 13 And as we showed in Chapters 3 and 4, it is crucial that all tests are done on test data and are representative of true out-of-sample classifier performance. One thing that is clear: running multiple models helps us pick the best model, which is the one that maximizes out-of-sample classifier performance for a given task. As we will see later, using an ensemble also has important positive consequences for downstream confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 现在,我们明白,这种多模式方法可能会增加成本,但根据我们的经验,在使用开放量模型时,这些成本仍然是相当可控的。 12 12 如果人们能够使用一个机构性GPU,那么研究者几乎没有成本,甚至没有成本。 否则,成本要么来自GPU的租金,对于本书中测试的模型和任务,租金通常在每小时0.5到1.5美元之间,要么来自DeepInfra(或类似的)API,该API对开放重量模型的每个象征性收费非常小. QLORA微调无论如何都需要GPU. 其背后还有一个明确的推理:正如我们在第4.6节中显示的那样,不同模型和任务之间的性能可能不同,模式也不完全清楚。 13 13,正如我们在第3章和第4章中所表明的那样,所有测试都必须用测试数据来进行,并且代表真正的抽样分类器性能。 有一点是清楚的: 运行多个模型可以帮助我们选择最佳模型, 这是对特定任务实现最大程度的外样本分类器性能. 稍后我们将看到,使用综艺节目也对下游信心间隔产生重要的积极影响。

blocks.en: An added benefit of this multi-model approach is that it allows us to get a strong overall understanding of LLM performance on our data. This in itself is valuable when reporting model choices. Currently, researchers often run the one model they know and take its performance as the best available. But that may not be the case, as a high-performing model in benchmarks may be a poor specific-task expert. Getting a holistic view of LLM performance with our data will help us confidently defend our model choice and communicate that in a transparent, convincing way. In all, selecting the best model maximizes measurement quality, but robustness depends on whether the finding survives different models and how these models differ. We turn to this key question now.
blocks.zh: 这种多模式方法的另一个好处是,它使我们能够在数据上获得对LLM性能的强烈全面理解. 这本身在报告模式选择时很有价值。 目前,研究人员经常使用他们知道的一个模型,并视其业绩为最佳可用模型。 但情况可能并非如此,因为基准方面的高绩效模式可能是一个较差的具体任务专家。 用我们的数据全面看待LLM的性能,将帮助我们自信地捍卫我们的模型选择,并以透明,令人信服的方式进行沟通. 总之,选择最佳模型可以最大限度地提高测量质量,但稳健性取决于发现是否存活于不同的模型,以及这些模型是如何不同的. 我们现在谈谈这个关键问题。

blocks.en: Error Structure and Disaggregation
blocks.zh: 错误结构和分类

blocks.en: By applying the BCH approach, we are in a position to select the best performer or set of performers for our task. Yet one problem remains that is key for RT: just because one model produces a better F1 score, it does not mean that it produces the best measure of a concept. If a given model far outperforms the rest, then it most likely does, but a single model rarely dominates. Most likely, a few LLMs will yield good results, and at that point we still must decide which model’s predictions we select for downstream inference. Do we select a best performer, or find a way to aggregate across them? This is, at the heart of it, one of the key issues in Barrie et al. (2024) . We will cover the harmonization step between LLM outputs and regression betas in Section 5.6.
blocks.zh: 通过采用《生物和人类健康手册》的方法,我们有能力为我们的任务选择最佳或最佳的表演者。 然而,对于RT来说,还有一个关键问题:仅仅因为一个模型能产生更好的F1分数,它并不意味着它能产生一个概念的最佳度量。 如果一个给定的模型远远超越了其余的,那么它最有可能做到,但一个单一的模型很少占据主导地位. 极有可能,一些有限责任公司将产生良好结果,届时我们仍然必须决定我们选择哪个模型进行下游推断。 我们是否选择一个表现最好的人,还是想方设法在他们中间聚集? 这是巴利等人(2024年)的关键问题之一。 我们将在第5.6节中说明LLM产出与回归β之间的统一步骤。

blocks.en: In our view, the answer lies in understanding not just the overall performance differences but how models differ. Blind aggregation or choosing the best performer naively is a poor default. Instead, we ought to examine where the models err, that is, their error structures . Are the models making mistakes in the same region of the data, or in different parts of it? Erring in the same regions suggests certain observations are intrinsically hard. Any model trained on similar data will find these genuinely ambiguous cases difficult to classify correctly. Errors in the same regions have two sources. First, the overlapping text corpora that most models use for training reproduce strengths and blind spots across model families. Second, the intrinsic ambiguity of hard texts leads to error, as even human expert coders are likely to disagree on how to code them.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,答案在于不仅了解总体业绩差异,而且了解模型的差异。 盲目聚合或天真地选择最佳表现者是一种差的默认. 相反,我们应当审查模型的错误之处,即它们的错误结构。 模型是在同一数据区域或数据的不同部分出错? 同一区域的错误表明,某些观察本身就很困难。 任何经过类似数据培训的模型都将发现这些真正含糊不清的案件难以正确分类。 同一区域的错误有两个来源。 首先,大多数模式用于培训的重叠文本公司复制了示范家庭的优势和盲点。 其次,硬文本的内在模糊性会导致错误,因为即使是人类专家的编码者也有可能在如何编码上出现分歧.

blocks.en: If all models miss on largely the same observations, aggregating results will not yield any meaningful improvements, which makes aggregation redundant. In these cases, the best solution is to simply pick the best performer, while at the same time reporting the comparisons, the benchmarks and the model error structures in an appendix. When multiple models perform similarly, we inevitably introduce some arbitrariness into the decision. 14 14 14 Note that this does not preclude aggregating the results as we suggest below for cases where models err in different regions. Yet picking the best performer and transparently reporting the process is a valid solution if error structures are very similar. Thus, the reassuring side of error-structure analysis is that it can yield principled, defensible model choices. And while this does not guarantee a similar error structure, when the procedure is repeated with different model families or versions, it makes similarity considerably more likely.
blocks.zh: 如果所有模型都忽略了基本上相同的观测结果,汇总结果不会产生任何有意义的改进,从而使汇总变得多余。 在这些情况下,最好的解决办法是简单地挑选表现最好的人,同时在附录中报告比较、基准和模型错误结构。 当多种模式运作类似时,我们不可避免地在决定中引入一些任意性。 14 14 请注意,这并不排除将结果汇总起来,我们在下文中建议在不同地区出现模式错误的情况。 然而,如果错误结构非常相似,选择最佳业绩者并透明地报告这一过程就是一个有效的解决办法。 因此,错误结构分析的令人安心的方面是,它能够产生有原则的、合理的模型选择。 而虽然这并不能保证类似的错误结构,但当该程序与不同的模型家族或版本重复时,它使得相似性大为可能.

blocks.en: More problematic is the case where error from various models is spread across different regions of the data. This suggests that performance is linked to differences in the training of each decoder, which poses a serious problem for robustness. We can still take the highest performer, but because error structures are different, the measure will inevitably carry the biases from the chosen model and affect downstream results.
blocks.zh: 更成问题的是,不同模型的错误分布在数据的不同区域。 这表明性能与每个解码器的训练差异有关,这给稳健性带来了严重问题. 我们仍然可以选择表现最高的人,但由于错误结构不同,计量必然会携带所选模型的偏差并影响下游结果.

blocks.en: In these cases, we argue that one solution is aggregation. When models err in different places, combining their predictions can allow the correct labels from one model to offset the mislabels from another. Say model A errs systematically on one category because of its training. By aggregating its labels with B’s and C’s, we can get a more reliable annotation for that specific observation. In our case, because the BCH approach uses at least five different models (RoBERTa, three few-shot open-weight decoders, and a QLoRA-fine-tuned decoder, plus optionally a closed-weight model), we can use a broad set of annotations for aggregation. 15 15 15 A note on RoBERTa: we include it in the final set of results for aggregation even though it is the only encoder in the list. The reason is that we care about producing the best final measure possible, and RoBERTa’s labels can be as strong as a decoder’s, and often better as Sections 3.7 and 4.6 show. So RoBERTa is both a benchmark in the measurement stage and part of the pool in the aggregation stage. From there, we can think of LLM codings in the same way we think of annotations from multiple human coders: we evaluate them using inter-coder reliability metrics and ask whether the final measure should require unanimity, four votes, or three.
blocks.zh: 在这种情况下,我们争辩说,一个解决办法是汇总。 当模型在不同的地方发生错误时,结合它们的预测可以允许一个模型的正确标签来抵消另一个模型的错标签. 说模式A会因为训练而系统地在某一类别上犯错。 通过将其标签与B和C的标签加在一起,我们可以得到关于这一具体观察的更可靠的说明。 在我们的情况中,由于BCH方法使用至少五个不同的模型(ROBERTA,三个几发的开放量级解码器,以及一个QLORA-fine-tuned解码器,加上一个可选的封闭量级解码器),我们可以使用一套广泛的说明来进行汇总. 15 15 关于RoBERTA的注解:我们把它列入最后的汇总结果集,尽管它是列表中唯一的编码器. RoBERTA的标签可以像解码器一样坚固, 也常常比第3. 因此,RoBERTa既是衡量阶段的基准,也是集合阶段池的一部分. 从这里,我们可以以同样的方式思考LLM编码,我们从多个人类编码器中想到说明:我们用编码器之间的可靠性度量来评价它们,并问最后的措施是需要全体一致,四票还是三票.

blocks.en: One option is majority voting, which is simple, transparent, and easy to reproduce. One important advantage is that it provides information about each classification’s reliability. A unanimous classification provides great certainty, while highly uncertain ones might be flagged for expert or manual review. 16 16 16 Researchers should prespecify the voting rule and tie-breaking rule, and show additional robustness by testing downstream estimation from alternative rules. However, majority voting relies on strong assumptions, namely that every model deserves equal weight and that errors are independent across models. The latter can reproduce errors, rather than correct them. Hovy et al. (2013) , for example, show that majority voting can fail when annotators differ substantially in competence. For decoder models, competence can translate into differences in training data and procedure.
blocks.zh: 一种选择是多数表决,它简单、透明和易于复制。 一个重要的优点是,它提供关于每个分类的可靠性的资料。 一致的分类提供了极大的确定性,而高度不确定的分类则可能被标出供专家或人工审查。 16 16名研究人员应预先说明投票规则和打结规则,并通过测试从其他规则中得出的下游估计,显示更大的活力。 然而,多数表决依赖于强有力的假设,即每个模型都应该得到同等的分量,而且各模型的错误是独立的。 后者可以重复错误,而不是纠正错误。 例如,Hovy等人(2013年)表明,当注释者在能力上存在重大差异时,多数投票可能失败。 对于解码器模型,能力可以转化为培训数据和程序的差异.

blocks.en: An alternative would be to produce a form of weighted aggregation. One option is to weight outputs by overall model performance. The logic here is that better-performing models produce more reliable labels and thus their outputs should carry more weight. Another option is to filter certain models out first, especially those whose overall performance is much below the rest. These outliers can be easily diagnosed and removed, much in the same way we would remove a bad and internally inconsistent human coder from a pool of coders. After filtering, we can run the aggregation on the surviving models. The key, however, is to drop only clear outliers, for one reason: in cases where models have different error structures, some of them may produce worse overall performance but better local performance in certain regions of the data. These differences are informative and valid during aggregation, yielding more accurate final labels.
blocks.zh: 另一种办法是提出一种加权汇总形式。 一种选择是按总体模式业绩衡量产出。 这里的逻辑是,性能较好的模型产生更可靠的标签,因此其产出应具有更大的分量. 另一种选择是先过滤出某些模型,特别是那些总体性能远低于其他模型的模型. 这些异常点可以很容易地被诊断和清除, 在很大程度上,我们同样会从一个编码器库中去掉一个坏的和内部不一致的人类编码器。 过滤后,我们可以在幸存的模型上运行汇总. 然而,关键在于只抛出明显的差值,原因之一是:在模型有不同错误结构的情况下,有些模型可能会产生较差的总体性能,但在数据的某些区域,当地性能会更好. 这些差异在汇总过程中是翔实和有效的,产生了更准确的最终标签.

blocks.en: More fundamentally, the error-structure analysis is a robustness diagnostic in itself. It tells us whether models agree and thus a result is robust to model choice, or whether results are model-dependent. It helps us understand whether we can simply select the best model or must aggregate across model results. Thus, we believe the approach of analyzing model error structures is a strong solution to the across-model robustness problem.
blocks.zh: 更根本的是,误差结构分析本身就是一种强健性诊断. 它告诉我们,模型是否同意,因此一个结果对于模型选择是强有力的,还是结果取决于模型。 它有助于我们了解,我们是否可以简单地选择最佳模式,还是必须综合各种模式的成果。 因此,我们认为分析模型错误结构的方法是解决跨模型强性问题的有力办法.

blocks.en: Researchers should then compare the best individual model with the aggregated alternative on the validation set. If aggregation does not improve performance, researchers can use the best performing model. If it does, then the aggregation approach can be adopted. BCH does not require aggregation but rather a transparent and validated process, informed by the error structure, that guides the researcher in their decision.
blocks.zh: 然后,研究人员应比较最佳个人模型和在验证组上的汇总替代品。 如果聚合不能提高性能,研究人员可以使用最佳性能模型. 如果这样做,就可以采用汇总办法。 《生物与健康分类》并不需要汇总,而是需要以错误结构为依据的透明和经过验证的过程,指导研究人员作出决定。

blocks.en: Error Structure Analysis on Three Datasets
blocks.zh: 三套数据集的错误结构分析

blocks.en: In this subsection, we use three datasets tested in Sections 3.7 and 4.6 to study the structure of annotation error — i.e., not how much each model errs, but where in the data they do so. We investigate whether different models make classification mistakes in similar or different areas of the data, which we argue will have important effects on downstream estimates. Where they do fail together, we examine whether the fault lies with the models or with the codebook. The data we use are from Ballard et al. (2023) , Trubowitz and Watanabe (2021) , and Foy-Sutherland (2025) . The first two datasets have one underperforming category — ‘uncivil’ and ‘unclear’ threats — and thus are helpful when analyzing where models disagree on certain texts and categories. In Foy-Sutherland , on the other hand, all models perform relatively well across categories, and thus error structures should be less variable.
blocks.zh: 在本小节中,我们使用第3.7节和第4.6节中测试的三个数据集来研究注释错误的结构——即不是每个模型发生多少错误,而是在数据中在哪里发生错误. 我们调查不同模型在类似数据领域或不同数据领域是否发生分类错误,我们提出,这将对下游估计产生重要影响. 在它们一起失败的地方,我们来检查 错误在于模型还是密码本。 我们使用的数据来自Ballard等人(2023年)、Trubowitz和渡边(2021年)以及Foy-Sutherland(2025年)。 前两个数据集有一个表现不佳的类别 -- -- " 不文明 " 和 " 不明确 " 的威胁,因此在分析模型在某些文本和类别上存在分歧时很有帮助。 在Foy-Sutherland(英语:Foy-Sutherland)中,在不同的类别中,所有模型的性能相对较好,因此误差结构应该变差较小.

blocks.en: The first finding is that decoders fail on the same observations more than they do with RoBERTa. In Ballard et al. , the mean decoder-decoder overlap is 0.52 (range 0.44–0.58), meaning that out of all the annotation errors decoders make, 52 percent are on average common to all pairs. In Trubowitz and Watanabe , the mean decoder-decoder overlap is higher, at 0.63. These figures are far higher than independent errors would produce. If the models’ mistakes were unrelated to each other, the overlap would sit near 0.13 in Ballard et al. and 0.12 in Trubowitz and Watanabe , the values noted above each panel.
blocks.zh: 第一项发现是,解码器在相同观测上发生故障的次数超过对RoBERTa的观测. 在Ballard等人案中,平均解码器-解码器的重叠值为0.52(范围为0.44–0.58),这意味着在所有解码器的注释错误中,平均52%是所有对子共同的。 在特鲁博维茨和渡边,平均解码器与解码器的重叠率较高,为0.63。 这些数字远远高于独立的错误。 如果模型的错误彼此无关,重叠将发生在Ballard等人的0.13和Trubowitz和渡边的0.12之间,这是上面每个面板提到的数值。

blocks.en: RoBERTa, on the other hand, produces errors that do not overlap as much with decoders — 0.24 and 0.27 in each task, respectively. And even though those overlaps are more than twice what chance would produce, they are substantially lower than the decoder-decoder overlaps. The overall pattern would suggest that some documents are simply hard for all models to label correctly, yet RoBERTa produces a different set of predictions. In these two tasks, decoders overlap around 2.2 times more with each other than with RoBERTa. The consequences are visible at the level of the corpus. In Ballard et al. , nearly half of all tweets (1,332, or 46.1 percent) are misclassified by at least one of the six models. Thus, reporting only model performance would be misleading, as per-model accuracy considerably overstates how much of this data models label reliably , and suggesting a high degree of model dependence. More telling is that 298 tweets (10.3 percent) defeat all five decoders at once, with RoBERTa recovering 182 of them. 17 17 17 Figure 5.1 shows that decoders share similar conceptual boundaries, probably because they are trained using similar data and procedures, and thus make similar errors. RoBERTa, on the other hand, appears to impose different category boundaries much less based on priors and more on the training data itself. Hence the importance, we think, of continuing to include RoBERTa in the loop of LLM-annotation and analysis. Note that an aggregation rule applied to unlabeled data would still need to determine when the encoder should override decoders. Knowing that the encoder errs on different observations than the decoders does not by itself change the rule, but it shows the importance of a heterogeneous pool of models. More broadly, the results show that models producing different patterns (e.g., encoders) are valuable for the comparison and aggregation stages of BCH.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,RoBERTa产生的错误与解码器的重叠程度不高——每次任务分别是0.24和0.27. 即使这些重叠是产生机会的两倍多,但它们大大低于解码器和解码器的重叠。 总体模式表明,有些文件对于所有模型来说都是难以正确标注的,然而RoBERTa却产生了一套不同的预测. 在这两项任务中,解码器相互重叠约2.2倍于罗贝塔. 后果在诉讼文书中显而易见。 在Ballard等人案中,几乎所有的推文(1,332,46.1%)被至少六个模型中的一个错误分类. 因此,只报告模型性能是误导性的,因为按模型的准确性大大夸大了这种数据模型中可靠地标注了多少,并暗示了高度的模型依赖性. 更能说明问题的是,298条微博(10.3%)同时击败了所有5条解码器,RoBERTa恢复了其中的182条。 17 17 17 图5.1显示,解码器在概念上有着相似的界限,这可能是因为他们接受过类似数据和程序的培训,因此也犯了类似的错误。 另一方面,RoBERTa似乎对不同的类别界限施加了更不基于前科的界限,对培训数据本身施加了更多界限。 因此,我们认为,必须继续将RoBERTa纳入LLM-说明和分析的循环。 请注意,对无标签数据适用的汇总规则仍需要确定编码器何时应超过解码器. 知道编码器在不同的观测上与解码器发生错误本身并不会改变规则,但显示了各种模型库的重要性. 更广泛地说,结果表明,产生不同模式的模型(如编码器)对于BCH的比较和聚合阶段是有价值的.

blocks.en: The poor performance on the ‘unclear’ category may reflect several factors. The category is relatively small ( n = 120 n=120 ), which gives encoder models fewer examples during fine-tuning ( Timoneda, 2026c , on remedies for sparse categories, see) . This might explain part of the results, but RoBERTa does well in Foy-Sutherland ’s positive class, also underrepresented. Alternatively, ‘unclear’ is a category with blurry boundaries that make it difficult to consistently identify in text. On the ‘yes’ category, on the other hand, RoBERTa only misses 26 percent of classifications compared to the best decoder at 54 percent. Decoders, across the board, confound ‘unclear’ and ‘yes’, and some significantly more than others. Again, the shared difficulty on these categories across models shows the importance of the codebook, which often signals the task’s performance ceiling, and categories that might require additional (human) review or additional (human) annotations.

blocks.en: Taken together, Figure 5.2 confirms that encoders and decoders fail on different categories, so picking only one model to build measures for downstream inference is difficult to justify. The fact that model performance changes significantly by task complicates this further. While RoBERTa often outperforms decoder models, the error structure is variable, sometimes attributed to data imbalance, sometimes to training methods and data. Model selection based solely on overall accuracy metrics can mislead and hide per-category limitations that might be substantively important (e.g., rare categories or theoretically interesting categories).
blocks.zh: 综合图5.2证实编码器和解码器在不同类别上失败,因此只选择一个模型来构建下游推论的计量方法是难以证明的. 模型性能因任务而发生重大变化的事实使这一问题更加复杂。 虽然RoBERTa经常超越了解码器模型,但错误结构是可变的,有时归因于数据不平衡,有时归因于训练方法和数据. 完全基于总体准确度衡量尺度的模型选择可以误导和隐藏可能具有实质性重要性的每个类别的限制(如稀有类别或理论上有趣的类别)。

blocks.en: The results from Ballard et al. provide a good illustration of this point. The best performing decoder (GPT-5.5-mini FS) has a greater miss rate imbalance between civil (0.16) and uncivil (0.47) tweets, while the fourth best decoder (Gemma 4 FS) does meaningfully better with uncivil tweets but this comes at the expense of worse performance on civil tweets. Thus, decoder 1 and decoder 4 for the Ballard et al. task will produce very different measures of the same concept. These differences do not mean that selecting only one model is never the right option. A model that performs best overall, produces desired class-specific accuracy, and outperforms the ensemble after the aggregation rule, will be a better choice than the ensemble. Rather, the results show why multi-model validation is important when applying LLMs in our research pipeline.
blocks.zh: Ballard等人的研究结果很好地说明了这一点。 最佳的解码器(GPT-5.5-mini FS)在民用(0.16)和不文明(0.47)的推文中存在较大的失差率不平衡,而第四佳的解码器(Gemma 4 FS)在不文明的推文中表现得更有意义,但这却牺牲了在民用推文上表现更差的代价. 因此,Ballard等人的解码器1和解码器4。 任务将产生非常不同的同一概念的衡量标准。 这些差异并不意味着只选择一个模型永远不是正确的选择. 总体表现最佳,产生所期望的类特异性精度的模型,在集合规则之后表现优于综艺,将比综艺更好选择. 相反,研究结果表明,在研究过程中应用有限责任公司时,多模式验证为何重要。

blocks.en: To conclude this section, Figure 5.3 shows the share of texts RoBERTa classifies correctly out of the ones that decoders get wrong. It also shows how much of the error would be expected if decoders were uncorrelated in how they classify text (vertical red line). The figure is a post hoc analysis that allows us to observe the information the encoder contributes, and not the performance of the aggregation rule.
blocks.zh: 最后,图5.3显示在解码器错误的文本中正确分类的文本比例。 它还显示,如果解码器在文本的分类方式(垂直红线)上不相关,那么预计会出现多少错误. 该图是后期分析,使我们能够观察编码器所贡献的信息,而不是聚合规则的性能.

blocks.en: The results are striking. In Ballard et al. , all five decoders misclassify 8 percent of ‘civil’ and 21 percent of ‘uncivil’ tweets. RoBERTa correctly classifies a significant proportion of those misses, indicating that its errors are different from the decoders’ errors. The gains are smaller in Foy-Sutherland , where all models already perform relatively well. The strongest example is the ‘yes’ category in Trubowitz and Watanabe . While all five decoders jointly misclassify 40 percent of these texts, RoBERTa correctly classifies more than half of the observations missed. Note that selecting RoBERTa alone would not produce a lower miss rate. RoBERTa’s miss rate for the ‘yes’ category is 26 percent, and it might err on observations the decoders classify correctly. A six-model majority rule rule would not necessarily correctly identify these cases either, since five similarly incorrect decoders would still outweigh the encoder’s correct vote. However, the results establish that there is a potential for improvement from the proposed ensemble approach.
blocks.zh: 结果是惊人的。 在Ballard等人的文章中, RoBERTa正确地将其中很大一部分错失分类,表明其错误不同于解码器的错误。 在福伊-萨瑟兰,收益较小,所有模型都表现得相对较好。 在Trubowitz和渡边, 虽然所有五个解码器都共同将40%的这些文本分类错误,但RoBERTa正确分类了超过一半的缺失的观测数据. 请注意, 仅选择 RoBERTa 将不会产生较低的失利率 。 RoBERTa的“是”类别误差率为26%, 六模式多数规则也不一定能正确识别这些案件,因为5个类似的不正确的解码器仍然会超过编码器正确的投票。 然而,结果证实,从拟议的共同办法来看,有改进的潜力。

blocks.en: The unclear category presents the opposite pattern. RoBERTa mislabels a similar share as the decoders. In practice, without gold labels, it is impossible to know from agreement alone whether lower performance is due to a codebook problem or an LLM blind spot for a certain category. It does point, however, to particular texts in the data that would benefit from manual adjudication, revision, or clarification. The main takeaway from Figure 5.3 is, therefore, that an ensemble approach where RoBERTa still has an important role can help us address the core issues of decoder performance and its differences across models.
blocks.zh: 不明确的类别呈现出相反的模式。 RoBERTa错误地给一个与解码器相似的共享标签. 在实践中,没有金色标签,单从协议中不可能知道低性能是由于代码簿问题,还是某个类别的LLM盲点. 然而,它确实指出了数据中可得益于人工裁决、修订或澄清的特定案文。 因此,从图5.3中取走的主要内容是,罗贝塔仍然发挥重要作用的综艺办法可以帮助我们解决解码器性能的核心问题及其各种模式之间的差异。

blocks.en: In this section, we have provided a series of robustness steps for LLM research. We encourage researchers to measure the performance of a heterogeneous group of models against an externally validated set, and compare it to performance after the aggregation rule, paying particular attention to the item- and class-specific error structure. Error diversity shows the importance of carrying out these tests, but it does not guarantee an improved measurement. This is still dependent on the correlation of the error structure of each individual model and the rules used to combine them.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们为LLM研究提供了一系列有力的步骤。 我们鼓励研究人员对照外部验证的一组模型,衡量一组不同模型的性能,并将其与汇总规则之后的性能进行比较,同时特别注意具体项目和类别的错误结构。 错误多样性表明进行这些测试的重要性,但并不能保证改进衡量。 这仍然取决于每个单个模型的错误结构与结合它们所使用的规则的关联性.

blocks.en: We have discussed simple voting rules as a transparent baseline for aggregation. They are not, however, the optimal aggregation strategy for every task. We encourage researchers to explore other rules and validate whichever one, from majority voting to performance-weighted stacking, best fits their data. The broader BCH recommendation then is that model selection or aggregation needs to be theoretically justified and empirically validated. Now, while improved measurement yields more accurate variables, we still must analyze the effects of LLM-derived measures on downstream analyses. The next section addresses this key issue.
blocks.zh: 我们讨论了简单的投票规则,作为汇总的透明基准。 然而,它们并不是每项任务的最佳汇总战略。 我们鼓励研究人员探索其他规则,并验证从多数投票到业绩加权堆放的任何规则,最符合他们的数据。 因此,《生物与健康分类》更广泛的建议是,模型的选择或汇总需要在理论上合理,并经过经验验证。 现在,虽然改进的测量得出更准确的变量,我们仍然必须分析LLM衍生的测量对下游分析的影响。 下一节讨论这个关键问题。

blocks.en: 5.6  Harmonizing LLM Measures and Downstream Estimates
blocks.zh: 5.6 统一LLM 措施和下游估计数

blocks.en: The Downstream Robustness Problem
blocks.zh: 下游强健问题

blocks.en: The challenge, as the previous section makes clear, is to produce valid, stable inference from LLM-derived measures. Doing so is difficult due to the variation both within and across different LLMs. Even small variations in the data can affect downstream estimates, especially in smaller samples. In terms of robustness, such variation signals model dependence, and questions the validity of findings built on a single model’s annotations.
blocks.zh: 正如上一节所明确指出的那样,面临的挑战是从LLM衍生的措施中得出有效、稳定的推论。 这样做很困难,因为不同有限责任公司内部和相互之间都有差异。 即使数据有小的变动也会影响下游的估计,特别是在较小的样本中. 就稳健性而言,这种变化表明模型依赖性,并对基于单一模型说明的结论的有效性提出质疑。

blocks.en: Variation in LLM classification output is a well-known phenomenon, and solutions like design-based supervised learning (DSL) have been put forward to address it ( Egami et al., 2023 ) . As we show in the next subsection, DSL corrects estimates toward the expert-coded benchmark, no matter how biased their coefficients are when compared to a gold-label regression. The central claim of DSL is that efficiently combining expert-annotated samples can produce valid statistical estimates, even when predicted variables contain non-random prediction errors, as is typical of LLM output. Thus, DSL can be applied as one of the harmonizing steps of BCH between LLM measures and downstream estimators. Since DSL allows for multiple LLM outputs to enter the prediction model, we examine empirically whether an ensemble approach reduces sensitivity to any one model, and how it improves the efficiency of the corrected downstream estimates.
blocks.zh: LLM分类输出中的变异是一个众所周知的现象,已经提出一些解决方案,如基于设计的监督学习(DSL)来解决(Egami等人,2023年). 正如我们在下一小节中显示的,DSL将估计数修正为专家编码的基准,不管它们的系数与金标签回归相比有多偏差。 DSL的中心主张是,高效结合专家附加说明的样本可以产生有效的统计估计,即使预测的变量包含非随机预测错误,正如LLM输出的典型. 因此,DSL可以作为《生物与健康分类》在LLM措施和下游估算之间协调的步骤之一加以应用。 由于DSL允许多个LLM输出进入预测模型,所以我们从经验上考察综艺方法是否降低了对任何一种模型的敏感性,以及它如何提高修正的下游估计的效率.

blocks.en: Yet relying on DSL for everything is problematic, for two reasons. The first is more conceptual. The fact that we always need a human sample to correct for LLM-induced coefficient bias and to re-estimate confidence intervals calls into question the very relevance of the LLMs themselves. As our tests below confirm, we have no choice but to apply DSL to every task because most LLM measures induce downstream bias. The second reason is more practical. While DSL corrects for coefficient biases, it must recalculate confidence intervals because the direction and size of the error are unknown ex ante. The CIs depend on the size of the gold sample, which is often small. So despite a large sample of LLM-labeled texts, we end up with wide confidence intervals after the DSL step, leading to more type-II errors. Cross-model variation and the CI problem motivate us to develop an ensemble approach to downstream analysis: drawing from multiple models leads to more stable coefficients and narrower CIs that remain valid. 18 18 18 The narrowing comes from a more informative surrogate, not from understating uncertainty; coverage is guaranteed by the DSL step throughout, so the gain is precision without a rise in false positives. The ensemble, therefore, completes the harmonize step between LLM measures and downstream estimators.
blocks.zh: 然而,由于两个原因,一切依赖DSL是有问题的。 第一个是概念性的。 我们总是需要一个人类样本来纠正LLM引起的系数偏差,并重新评估信任间隔,这一事实使人们对LLM本身的关联性产生疑问。 正如我们下面的测试所证实的,我们别无选择,只能将DSL应用于每一项任务,因为大多数LLM措施都会诱发下游偏差. 第二个原因是更实际的。 虽然DSL纠正系数偏差,但它必须重新计算信任间隔,因为错误的方向和大小是事先未知的. CI取决于黄金样本的大小,这往往很小. 因此,尽管LLM标记的文本有很多样本,我们最终在DSL步骤后会有宽广的置信间隔,导致更多的II型错误. 跨模型变异和CI问题激励我们开发出一种对下游分析的共性方法:从多种模型中提取可以导致更稳定的系数和更窄的CI,这些系数和CI仍然有效. 18 18 缩小来自一个更翔实的代词,而不是低调的不确定性;覆盖在整个DSL步骤中得到保证,因此收益是精准的,而不增加假阳性. 因此,综艺节目完成了LLM措施与下游估计器之间的协调步骤.

blocks.en: Testing Measurement-Choice Sensitivity on Downstream Betas
blocks.zh: 测试下游贝塔的测量-选择敏感性

blocks.en: Our conceptual contribution concerns the variance of downstream betas conditional on the choice of LLM for measurement. Barrie et al. (2024) show that LLM choice can move downstream estimates, and we build on this insight by connecting it to the models’ error structures and testing what the DSL correction can and cannot repair. In this section, we test our argument empirically, with two explicit goals. The first is to estimate the variance of downstream betas produced by different LLM measures. The second is to estimate whether lower variance from high-performing models yields more stable DSL corrections. For the tests, we again use data from Ballard et al. (2023) , Trubowitz and Watanabe (2021) , and Foy-Sutherland (2025) , as in Section 5.5. The first two are high-sensitivity cases, since per-category performance varies substantially across configurations in both datasets (see Table 4.3 of the book). Foy-Sutherland , on the other hand, serves as a low-sensitivity comparison that remains stable across all decoder and encoder specifications. With this third dataset, and if our account is right, the downstream estimates should be similar across LLM measures.
blocks.zh: 我们的概念贡献涉及下游β的差别,条件是选择LLM进行测量. Barrie et al. (2024) 表明LLM选择可以移动下游的估计,我们通过将它与模型的错误结构连接起来,测试DSL校正能够和不能修复的东西,来在这个见解的基础上更进一步. 在本节中,我们以两个明确的目标,从经验上检验我们的论点。 第一是估计不同LLM度量产生的下游β的差值. 第二是估计与高性能模型的较低差异是否产生更稳定的DSL校正. 对于测试,我们再次使用Ballard等人(2023年)、Trubowitz和渡边(2021年)以及Foy-Sutherland(2025年)的数据,如第5.5节。 前两个是高度敏感的案例,因为两个数据集的每个类别的业绩在配置上差别很大(见本书表4.3)。 另一方面,Foy-Sutherland是一种低敏感性的比较,在所有解码器和编码器规格上保持稳定。 有了这第三个数据集,如果我们的账户是正确的,下游的估计数应该与LLM计量方法相似。

blocks.en: The design of the tests is as follows. We hold a downstream regression specification fixed and vary only the source of the measured variable. We run separate regressions using (1) only the human gold labels, which serve as our expert-coded benchmark β ^ g ​ o ​ l ​ d \hat{\beta}_{gold} ; (2) labels from each of the separate decoder models and configurations (few-shot/zero-shot) evaluated in Chapter 4; and (3) the RoBERTa-large measures from Chapter 3. 19 19 19 To draw actual per-observation predictions from RoBERTa-large, we ran a single seeded ten-fold pass per dataset. The out-of-fold performance closely matches the scores reported in Chapter 3. For instance, Ballard et al. ’s run returned a 0.722 macro-F1 compared to Chapter 3’s 0.720. Because every configuration produces its own version of the measure, it also yields its own downstream estimate of the coefficient of interest. We compare the LLM-derived betas with the human-labeled ground truth coefficients, computing the deviations and the variance across model betas. Deviations are calculated as the difference between each model estimate β ^ m \hat{\beta}_{m} and β ^ g ​ o ​ l ​ d \hat{\beta}_{gold} . Lastly, while DSL’s validity guarantee holds regardless of which measure it corrects, its variance depends on how informative that measure is. More accurate predictions improve DSL efficiency, but accuracy cannot be the sole criterion for model choice. Errors correlated with the variables in the model, such as party, year, or incumbency, may matter more than other error types, even in less accurate models. Still, better precision at the measurement stage generally yields more precise DSL-corrected betas.

blocks.en: We run a standard multivariate linear probability model for downstream analyses. 20 20 20 We keep the model choice deliberately simple and consistent across datasets to make the tests parsimonious and comparable. Whether the effects of LLM measures on downstream betas vary with the choice of statistical model is beyond our scope and should be the object of further research. We use the LLM-derived measure as the dependent variable and include three variables from the original data sources in the regression as predictors. In Ballard et al. , for example, we regress the incivility label on the member’s party, chamber, and gender, with the party coefficient as the main estimate of interest — i.e., whether one party’s rhetoric registers as more uncivil than another’s. A final clarification is that the human-labeled data are used twice in the design. The first is to produce the ground-truth β ^ g ​ o ​ l ​ d \hat{\beta}_{gold} . The second is to implement DSL. We simulate a researcher who hand-labels only 10 or 20 percent of the corpus and applies the DSL correction to the downstream estimates. 21 21 21 We also report results using 50 and 100 percent of the sample for comparison.

blocks.en: The results from Figure 5.4 are striking. All naive measures from decoder models produce coefficients with positive signs, and eight of ten are statistically significant, while the gold benchmark is negative . This sign reversal is highly problematic on its own and highlights the need for correction. DSL’s estimates mirror the benchmark across all models. However, despite the coefficient correction, DSL is less precise because it is estimated in a smaller sample of gold labels. Only at around 50 percent of the full sample do DSL confidence intervals begin to approximate those of the true model. In this application, RoBERTa, the best-performing model in Table 4.2 of the book, yields unbiased coefficients that mirror the results of the true benchmark without the need for correction. It also offers more precise confidence intervals almost as narrow as the gold benchmark’s. 22 22 22 We know RoBERTa is close to the benchmark only because we hold the full set of gold labels. A researcher with a 10 or 20 percent sample can only see that their model performs well on the validation set. As Section 4.6 showed, this does not guarantee an unbiased downstream coefficient. The DSL step converts that uncertainty into a guarantee, but does so at the price in precision we document in this section.

blocks.en: Figure 5.5 reports the results for the Trubowitz and Watanabe task using the same structure as the previous figure. The dependent variable is dichotomous and captures whether an article conveys a political threat. The main explanatory variable is year, and the controls are ‘foreign’ and ‘wartime’. 23 23 23 We take ‘year’ as the focal predictor because it represents an intermediate case: model errors correlate with it less strongly than with ‘wartime’ but more than with ‘foreign’, making it a fair test of the correction. The best-performing model for the task from Chapter 4, GPT-5.5 with few-shot CoT, performs well, as its coefficient and CIs closely mirror the gold-label benchmark. The substantive results would not change using RoBERTa, but its point estimate is still slightly higher than the benchmark, despite being within its confidence interval. There is also more variability across other decoders, with some like Mistral or Llama overstating the effect and GPT-5.5-mini few-shot understating it. As with Ballard et al. , applying DSL again corrects the coefficient deviations well, but the added uncertainty could affect significance readings. Ideally, in this task, we would use GPT-5.5’s codings without correction, but researchers do not know the ground truth ex ante if they do not have the full set of coded samples in hand.
