blocks.en: Figure 5.6 reports the results for the Foy-Sutherland task. The outcome for negative attack ads is binary, dichotomized from the three-class classifier (negative, contrast and positive). As independent variables, we use an incumbency dummy as the main predictor and the candidate’s party and gender as controls. In this task, the best-performing models yield downstream coefficients similar to the gold-label benchmark. RoBERTa matches the best decoder, while other decoders overestimate the effect. DSL corrects these estimates well, but again introduces wider confidence intervals at smaller gold sample sizes. Notice that we predicted these Foy-Sutherland results at the start of this section: in a task with similar error structures across models, downstream betas are more consistent as model choice barely affects them.
blocks.zh: 图5.6报告了福伊-萨瑟兰任务的结果。 负面攻击广告的结果为二进制,从三类分类器(负,对比和正)中二进制. 作为独立的变量,我们使用一个在职假人作为主要预测者,候选人的党和性别作为控制者。 在这一任务中,表现最好的模型产生类似于金标签基准的下游系数. RoBERTa与最佳解码器匹配,而其他解码器则高估了效果. DSL很好地纠正了这些估计,但再次在较小的黄金样本尺寸下引入了更大的置信间隔. 注意我们在本节开头预言了这些福伊-萨瑟兰结果:在一个跨模型的类似错误结构的任务中,下游β更加一致,因为模型选择几乎不会影响它们.

blocks.en: These three results hold some important lessons for downstream inference from LLM-derived measures. First, model choice significantly affects regression coefficients, and the problem is that their effects are unpredictable. In Ballard et al. , we observe a sign flip and significantly distorted decoder estimates, while the encoder mirrored the benchmark. In Trubowitz and Watanabe , the best-performing decoder followed the gold benchmark closely, while RoBERTa and other decoders overstated the effect. In Foy-Sutherland , both RoBERTa and the best decoders were unbiased with CIs close to the gold benchmark’s, and other decoders again overstated the effect.
blocks.zh: 这三项结果为下游从LLM衍生的措施中推断出一些重要的教训。 首先,模型选择会显著影响回归系数,问题在于其效果是不可预测的. 在Ballard等人案中,我们观察到一个标志翻转和明显扭曲的解码器估计,而编码器则与基准镜像. 在特鲁博维茨和渡边,表现最好的解码器紧跟金本位,而罗贝塔和其他解码器则夸大了效果. 在Foy-Sutherland, RoBERTa和最好的解码器都对接近黄金基准的CI没有偏见,其他解码器再次夸大了效果。

blocks.en: Second, in all cases, the DSL correction yields unbiased coefficients, which highlights the importance of the approach when dealing with downstream estimation with LLM-derived measures. 24 24 24 Recall that DSL requires a hand-labeled subsample drawn as a probability sample, fully at random and with known inclusion probabilities, as in our simulations. A researcher who instead hand-codes a selection of documents (the most recent, the most ambiguous, the easiest to code) for convenience breaks the correction. DSL did well even in the worst scenarios, such as GPT-5.5-mini zero-shot’s performance on the Ballard et al. data, with 48 percent of rows mislabeled, errors concentrated on the party variable, and a sign-flipped naive β ^ \hat{\beta} . It also corrected Mistral few-shot’s +0.232 overestimation on the same dataset. DSL recovered every one of these estimates and placed them within ≈ \approx 0.02 of the gold-label benchmark. However, it is worth noting that when the DSL sample is small, the estimate can be imprecise, which then affects statistical significance. In fact, all figures show that at 10 or 20 percent of the full sample, DSL-derived CIs are significantly wider than those of both the naive regressions and the gold benchmark. This problem is unlikely to lead to an increase in false positives, so in that sense it is safe, but it may yield a substantially higher number of false negatives (type-II errors), making it more difficult for researchers to establish relationships that do, in fact, exist. For this reason, we introduce a refinement that reduces uncertainty in downstream estimates.
blocks.zh: 第二,在所有情况下,DSL校正均产生无偏差系数,这凸显了在用LLM衍生措施处理下游估计时这一方法的重要性。 24 24 记得DSL要求像我们的模拟一样,用手标子样本作为概率样本,完全随机抽取,并有已知的纳入概率。 研究者为了方便而用手编码选定文件(最新,最模棱两可,最容易编码)则打破校正. DSL即使在最糟糕的情况下也表现良好,例如GPT-5.5-mini-0shot在Ballard等人数据上的性能,有48%的列错标,错误集中在派对变量上,以及一个标志性的天真 β ^\\ hat\beta}. 也纠正了Mistral few-shot对同一数据集的+0.232高估. DSL收回了这些估计中的每一个,并将它们置于\\\\\\ 0.02 金标签基准中。 然而,值得注意的是,当DSL样本很小时,估计可能不准确,从而影响统计意义. 事实上,所有数字都显示,在全部样本的10%或20%,DSL衍生的CI比天真回归和黄金基准的CIS要大得多。 这个问题不太可能导致假阳性病的增加,因此从这个意义上讲是安全的,但它可能会产生大量假阴性病(类型-II错误),使得研究人员更难建立事实上确实存在的关系. 为此,我们提出了一种改进办法,以减少下游估计数的不确定性。

blocks.en: Our Approach: Reducing Variance in Downstream Estimates
blocks.zh: 我们的方法:减少下游估计数中的差异

blocks.en: The previous subsection shows a key vulnerability in current correction approaches: while DSL works in producing valid downstream coefficients, researchers enter a sort of ‘precision lottery’ around those estimates. The reason is that downstream CIs depend heavily on model choice: a better model for the task will yield narrower CIs than a worse model, even if DSL corrects any estimate and makes it valid. Figure 5.7 displays this graphically. If a researcher happens to pick the worst decoder for the Ballard et al. (2023) task, GPT-5.5-mini zero-shot, the resulting confidence intervals with DSL at 10 percent of the gold subsample will be 84 percent wider (0.46 vs 0.25), and almost 6 times wider than the full gold sample’s. At 20 percent of the full sample, DSL’s CIs are still 88 percent wider. These numbers improve with the best decoder, GPT-5.5-mini few-shot, but they are still 20 percent wider with the same subsample share (0.30 vs 0.25). Two problems arise. First, researchers cannot know ex ante which decoder will produce the best results, as Section 4.6 shows — hence the term ‘lottery’. The second issue is the effects of lack of precision. While DSL ensures we obtain valid estimates and reduces the risk of type-I errors (false positives), we are gravely at risk of type-II errors (false negatives), and thus discarding potentially valuable findings.
blocks.zh: 上一小节显示了当前校正方法中的一个关键弱点:虽然DSL致力于产生有效的下游系数,但研究人员在这些估计数字周围输入某种“精密的彩票”。 原因是下游的CI严重依赖模型选择:更好的任务模型将产生比更糟糕的模型更窄的CI,即使DSL校正任何估计,使其有效. 图5.7以图形方式显示了这一点。 如果研究者碰巧为Ballard等人(2023年)的任务选取了最差的解码器GPT-5.5-mini-0-shot,那么由此产生的与DSL的置信间隔在金子样本的10%上将会是84%(0.46对0.25)的宽度,几乎是黄金样本的6倍。 在全部样本中,DSL的CI仍然在88%的范围内。 这些数字随着最佳解码器GPT-5.5-mini point-shot而有所改善,但是它们仍然以相同的子样本份额(0.30对0.25)而扩大20%. 出现两个问题。 首先,研究者无法事先知道哪个解码器将产生最佳结果,正如第4.6节所显示的——因此是“批量”一词。 第二个问题是缺乏精确性的影响。 虽然DSL确保我们获得有效的估计并降低I型错误(假阳性)的风险,但我们面临II型错误(假阴性)的严重风险,从而抛弃了潜在的有价值的发现.

blocks.en: To address this core inference issue, we suggest two alternative complementary workflows to standard DSL. Both aim to narrow CIs toward the gold benchmark while retaining validity. The first approach is for decoder LLMs and consists in applying DSL over an ensemble of models. To implement and evaluate the ensemble approach, we first split each dataset’s full labeled sample into a validation half and a deployment half. On the validation half, we run a logistic regression with the gold label as the dependent variable and the labels from the three open-weight models (Gemma, Llama, and Mistral) as the predictors. Then we apply this fitted model to the deployment half of the data. In it, for each observation, the model takes the three labels it received and returns a single predicted probability that the observation’s gold label equals one. These probabilities, one per observation, are the stacked surrogate. This surrogate is the y ^ \hat{y} that DSL uses to build its pseudo-outcome. All downstream estimation takes place on the deployment half. There, we simulate a researcher who hand-labels a random 10 or 20 percent of observations (50 and 100 percent serve as comparison points only). Only these drawn gold labels enter the DSL correction. In practice, researchers need not split any data. A single labeled subsample, drawn at random with known inclusion probability, can rank the models, fit the stacking weights, and feed the DSL correction. It is important that the weights be cross-fitted. 25 25 25 Cross-fitting keeps the surrogate independent of the gold labels used in the correction ( Egami et al., 2023 ) . With a small stacking model, three coefficients, this costs one line of code: fit the weights on K − 1 K-1 folds, predict the held-out fold, so every observation’s surrogate is out-of-fold. Figure 5.8 shows the comparison between our ensemble and standard DSL.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一核心推论问题,我们建议采用标准DSL的两个补充工作流程。 两者都旨在将关键指标缩小到黄金基准,同时保持有效性。 第一种方法是用于解码器LLMs,包括将DSL应用到一组模型上. 为了实施和评估综艺方法,我们首先将每个数据集的完整标注样本分成验证半和部署半。 在验证半上,我们运行一个逻辑回归,黄金标签作为依赖变量,三个开量模型(Gemma、Llama和Mistral)的标签作为预测器。 然后我们把这个安装的模型 应用到一半的数据上 在其中,对于每个观察,模型取其收到的三个标签,并返回一个单一的预测概率,即观察的黄金标签等于一个. 这些概率,每观测一次,就是堆叠的代孕. 这个代词是 y ^\ hat{y} DSL 用来构建其伪结果的 。 所有下游估计都是在部署一半时进行的。 在那里,我们模拟一位将随机的10%或20%的观测结果(50%和100%仅作为比较点)贴上手标签的研究人员。 只有这些绘制的金色标签才输入 DSL 更正 。 在实践中,研究人员不需要分割任何数据. 单个标注的子样本,以已知的包含概率随机抽取,可以对模型进行排序,匹配堆叠重量,并反馈DSL校正. 重要的是,权重要交叉配对. 25 25 交叉配对使代位器独立于修正中使用的金牌(Egami等人,2023年). 用一个小的堆叠模型,三个系数,这需要一行代码: 符合K−1K-1折叠上的权重, 预测悬叠, 所以每个观察的代位是外置的. 图5.8显示了我们的综艺节目和标准DSL的比较.

blocks.en: To keep costs down, we use only the open-weight models we tested in this book --- Gemma, Llama and Mistral. 26 26 26 We use the few-shot variants because they tend to perform better on average. That said, researchers are welcome to use a different decoder ensemble, either including some closed-weight alternatives and/or zero-shot prompting variants. The ensemble yields CIs indistinguishable from the gold subsample and improves on the best decoder’s DSL precision by 23 percent at 10 percent of the subsample, 24 percent at 20 percent, and 15 percent at 50 percent. That said, even at 50 percent of gold labels, the ensemble still produces CIs wider than the full gold sample’s, 0.11 vs 0.08. But the gap is much smaller than standard DSL with either the worst or best decoder. Thus, using a three-model open-weight ensemble addresses two issues. First, it solves the problem of having to select the best model, which is not possible ex ante. Second, although the size of the gain is task-dependent, it can reduce DSL-derived CIs significantly.
blocks.zh: 为了降低成本,我们只使用我们在本书中测试过的开放式模型————Gemma,Llama和Mistral. 26,我们使用几发的变体,因为它们一般表现较好。 尽管如此,欢迎研究人员使用不同的解码器组合,要么包括一些封闭重量替代品和/或零镜头激发变体。 综艺节目的CI与金子样本无法区分, 最佳解码器的DSL精度提升了23%, 10%的分样本, 24%的20%, 15%的50%。 尽管如此,即便在50%的金牌上, 综艺节目仍比黄金样本更广泛, 但差距比标准DSL小得多,要么是最差的,要么是最好的解码器. 因此,采用三种模式的开放式加权综艺节目解决了两个问题。 首先,它解决了必须选择最佳模式的问题,这是事先不可能做到的. 第二,虽然增益的大小取决于任务,但可以大大减少DSL衍生的CI.

blocks.en: Figure 5.9 shows the results for the Foy-Sutherland (2025) and Trubowitz and Watanabe (2021) tasks. As expected in Foy-Sutherland , models are the most consistent, which matches the results from this chapter and Section 4.6. Again, the ensemble improves on the best decoder, although the margins are smaller in both tasks. Still, the ensemble is the best decoder -based option: it removes the need to select the best model and still yields better performance than the best decoder.

blocks.en: While the ensemble solution applies only to decoder LLMs, the second uses RoBERTa. We would be remiss if we did not note, from Figures 5.8 and 5.9 , that RoBERTa’s results are the most consistently precise of all models. They are also valid, with the estimates in two tasks practically identical to the benchmark and one slightly overstated but within its confidence interval. In fact, based on the tests above, the average decoder needs nearly twice the hand-labeling (18.8 percent of the corpus rather than 10) to match the width of RoBERTa’s interval. These results lead us to the second solution: apply a fine-tuned RoBERTa encoder to the full sample, and use the training data benchmark (the same DSL uses) to correct the final downstream estimates. This solution is a supervised-encoder implementation of DSL.
blocks.zh: 虽然综艺解决方案只适用于解码器LLMS,但第二种则使用RoBERTa. 如果我们不从图5.8和5.9中注意到罗贝塔的结果是所有模型中最一贯准确的,那我们就失职了。 它们也是有效的,两项任务的估计与基准基本相同,一项略微夸大,但在信任的间隔内。 事实上,根据上述测试,平均解码器需要近两倍的手贴标签(占体积的18.8%而不是10)才能与RoBERTa的间隔宽度相匹配。 这些结果导致我们找到第二个解决方案:将经过微调的RoBERTa编码器应用到完整的样本中,并使用培训数据基准(同样的DSL用途)来修正最后的下游估计. 这个解决方案是DSL监督的编码器执行.

blocks.en: To explain this second solution, we need to situate the downstream analysis in the broader context of the data. When a researcher has a small amount of data, we highly recommend using a decoder ensemble, as it requires less human annotation, yields valid estimates through the DSL step, and reduces the CIs as much as possible to lower the chance of a type-II error. Fine-tuning a RoBERTa model on the full dataset makes little sense. However, a researcher may have a lot of texts and the decision is between (1) using a decoder and applying DSL with a small validation set or (2) building a full training set for fine-tuning RoBERTa (or a decoder with QLoRA). Here is where we think fine-tuning RoBERTa still has an edge that is difficult to surpass. Our tests have shown that RoBERTa generally produces strong estimates, and the CIs mirror those of the full gold-label benchmark because that is the sample it uses for fine-tuning. The second solution, therefore, is to run DSL with RoBERTa as the surrogate: the researcher applies the fine-tuned classifier to the full corpus, producing a predicted label for every document. We use the out-of-fold predictions for the training observations themselves, so the surrogate never sees its own gold labels. The training set then serves as the gold subsample in the DSL step. The corrected estimates are unbiased and the CIs are also as narrow as in the gold-benchmark regression. 27 27 27 The width of the corrected interval is anchored to the gold-benchmark sample, not to the size of the corpus, but it is scaled by the quality of the encoder: it is narrower than the gold-only interval whenever the encoder’s per-document error falls below the outcome’s residual variance, and wider when it does not. This break-even condition can be computed from the validation sample before a single document of the full corpus is labeled. Note that this approach, incidentally, also helps prevent type-I errors emerging from large sample sizes common to text sources.
blocks.zh: 为了解释第二个解决方案,我们需要将下游分析置于更广泛的数据背景下。 当研究者拥有少量数据时,我们强烈建议使用解码器共解码器,因为它需要较少的人文注释,通过DSL步骤得出有效的估计,并尽可能减少CI,以降低发生第二类错误的可能性. 在完整的数据集上精细调整一个RoBERTa模型没有什么意义. 然而,研究者可能有很多文本,决定介于 (1) 使用解码器与应用DSL并带有一个小的验证器或 (2) 建立一套完整的训练器以微调RoBERTa(或与QLORA的解码器)之间. 这里,我们认为,微调RoBERTA 仍然有一个难以超越的边缘。 我们的测试表明,RoBERTA一般能产生强有力的估计值,而CIs与全金标签基准的比较,因为这是它用来微调的样本. 因此,第二个解决方案是用RoBERTa作为替身运行DSL:研究者将精细的分类器应用到全体,为每份文件生成一个预测的标签. 我们用外部的预测来进行训练观察本身,因此代孕者从不看到自己的金牌. 训练集然后作为DSL阶梯中的金子样本. 校正后的估算是没有偏见的,而且CI也和黄金基准回归中一样狭窄。 27 27 校正后的间隔的宽度被固定在黄金基准样本上,而不是实体大小上,而是被编码器的质量所放大:当编码器的每份文件误差低于结果的剩余差异时,它比纯黄金的间隔要窄,如果不是,则更大。 这种中断均匀条件可以从鉴定样本中计算出来,然后才给完整的文件贴上标签。 请注意,顺便指出,这种方法还有助于防止文本来源常见的大样本大小产生的I型错误。

blocks.en: In all, one way to describe the challenges of using LLMs as annotators is that they put researchers between a rock and a hard place: either they use an LLM blindly and risk biased downstream estimates, or they use DSL with a small gold-labeled sample to correct for bias but obtain imprecise estimates. The latter is certainly preferable to the former, but neither is ideal. The main takeaway, for us, is that we cannot fully turn our backs on building a training set if we want to ensure that both betas and CIs are valid for downstream inference. The remaining decision point for a researcher is how much data to label. If there are clear resource constraints, labeling a small set and applying DSL with an ensemble of open-weight LLMs is a good option. The costs are somewhat wider intervals than a full gold sample would give, and a weaker basis for judging LLM performance on a specific task. If resources are not a problem, a larger labeled set unlocks the fine-tuning options through encoders and QLoRA, which yield the narrowest valid CIs our tests have produced.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,将LLMs作为注释者来描述挑战的一种方式是,它们将研究人员置于岩石和硬地方之间:要么盲目使用LLM,并冒着偏颇的下游估计,要么使用带有小金标本的DSL来纠正偏差,但获得不准确的估计. 后者当然比前者更可取,但两者都不理想。 对我们来说,主要外卖是,如果我们想要确保β和CI对下游推论都有效,我们就不能完全放弃建立一套训练。 研究者剩下的决定点是贴上多少数据标签. 如果有明显的资源限制,将一个小集标签并应用一个全称的开放式LLMSL是一个很好的选择. 成本的间隔比完整的黄金样本要宽一些,在具体任务上判断LLM性能的基础更弱。 如果资源不是问题,一个更大的标签集会通过编码器和QLORA解锁微调选项,它们产生我们测试产生的最窄的有效CI.

blocks.en: 5.7  Transparency and Disclosure
blocks.zh: 5.7 透明度和披露

blocks.en: More than a methodological issue, transparency is a normative one. As a discipline, we have adopted general standards of disclosure and data availability, such as APSA’s Data Access and Research Transparency (DA-RT) initiative. And while there have been improvements in this area, there is still much work to do ( Grossman and Pedahzur, 2021 ; Rainey et al., 2025 ) . This is not limited to research using LLMs, although LLMs pose new challenges ( Grossmann et al., 2023 ; Abdurahman et al., 2025 ; Feuerriegel et al., 2026 , see) . We echo these calls. The disclosure standards already in place at top journals are the floor, and yet they have not closed the reporting gap, least of all for LLM-based work.
blocks.zh: 透明度不仅仅是一个方法问题,也是一个规范性问题。 作为一个学科,我们采用了公布和提供数据的一般标准,例如亚太航天局的数据获取和研究透明度倡议。 尽管这一领域有所改进,但仍有许多工作要做(Grossman和Pedahzur,2021年;Rainey等人,2025年)。 这不限于使用LLMs的研究,尽管LLMs带来了新的挑战(Grossmann等人,2023年;Abdurahman等人,2025年;Feuerriegel等人,2026年,见). 我们响应这些呼吁。 高层期刊已经实行的披露标准是最低的,然而,这些标准并没有弥补报告差距,尤其是基于LLM的工作。

blocks.en: Table 5.1 : Information to Disclose When Using LLMs
blocks.zh: 表5.1:在使用法学硕士时要披露的信息

blocks.en: With LLMs, the key issues are what to disclose, what to make available, and how. In terms of disclosure, researchers must first disclose model name, exact version, hyperparameters, and modifications, meaning any further pre-training, fine-tuning, quantization, or adapters applied to the released checkpoint. Computational equipment details and any external computing service or API used must also be disclosed. We provide a complete overview of disclosure criteria in Table 5.1 . For example, a researcher who fine-tunes or further trains a RoBERTa model on Verda or AWS should report the provider and instance. Any additional training data should also be described in detail (see Table 5.2 ). The date of access is also essential, since models change or get deprecated.
blocks.zh: 关于有限责任公司,关键问题是披露什么、提供什么以及如何提供。 在披露方面,研究人员必须首先披露模型名称、准确版本、超参数和修改,即任何进一步的培训前、微调、量化或适用于已放行检查站的适配器。 计算设备细节和所使用的任何外部计算服务或API也必须披露。 我们全面概述了表5.1中的披露标准。 例如,在Verda或AWS上微调或进一步培训RoBERTa模型的研究人员应报告提供者和实例。 还应详细说明任何其他培训数据(见表5.2)。 访问日期也至关重要,因为模型会改变或贬值。

blocks.en: Table 5.2 : Examples of different LLM applications
blocks.zh: 表5.2:不同LLM应用的实例

blocks.en: For availability, the default should be to release everything the license and ethics allow. We are in an age of low data storage costs and ample repository availability. Setting aside the common exceptions (confidentiality, security, informed-consent limits), researchers should make the following readily available: code, prompts, codebooks, training and validation data, analysis data, and trained models. 28 28 28 Availability requires a certain degree of trust in current repositories and platforms. GitHub and Hugging Face, for example, are invaluable resources for researchers, but repositories hosted there might change after publication or without notice; the platforms themselves might change or disappear. Ideally, all archived versions should be assigned a DOI or a similar persistent identifier. All published material should link back to that identifier, preserving the dated version of the reported material, while allowing the researcher to continue maintaining a working repository. In what follows we describe how each should be made available.
blocks.zh: 就可用性而言,缺省情况应当是发放许可证和道德标准允许的一切。 我们正处于一个数据存储成本低和储存库供应充足时代。 除了共同的例外(保密性、安全性、知情同意的限度)之外,研究人员应提供下列现成资料:代码、提示、代码簿、培训和验证数据、分析数据和训练有素的模型。 28 28 可用性要求对目前的储存库和平台具有一定程度的信任。 例如,GitHub和Hugging Face对研究人员来说是宝贵的资源,但在那里托管的寄存器在出版后或未经通知就可能改变;平台本身可能改变或消失。 理想的情况是,所有存档的版本都应指定一个DOI或类似的持久性标识符. 所有已出版的材料都应与该识别资料链接,保留报告材料的过时版本,同时允许研究人员继续维持一个工作储存库。 在下文中,我们描述了应如何提供每种服务。

blocks.en: Code Scripts
blocks.zh: 代码脚本

blocks.en: Regardless of model, a general rule is that all code should be self-contained, annotated, and easily interpretable. By self-contained, we mean that researchers should be able to run the complete workflow with minimal changes. If fine-tuning an encoder model, the code should point to the correct repositories to access the same exact model version, 29 29 29 See the Trained Models section for model availability. and the correct training data using relative paths. If using a fine-tuned model, the code should point to the correct repositories or folders that store the model, the tokenizer and the data. When using a decoder model, the code should include either the API call used to access it or the correct repository that stores it. The exception is secret API keys, which should never be shared nor hardcoded into replication scripts. The code does need to indicate where to place the API key.
blocks.zh: 不论型号如何,一个通则是所有代码都应该是自成一体的,附加说明的,并且易于解释. 通过自成一体,我们的意思是研究者应该能够以最小的变化来运行完整的工作流程. 如果对编码器模型进行微调,代码应该指向正确的寄存器访问相同的准确的模型版本,29 29 请参看"训练模型"中的模型可用性部分. 以及使用相对路径的正确培训数据。 如果使用经过微调的模型,代码应该指向存储模型的正确寄存器或文件夹,表示器和数据. 在使用解码器模型时,代码应当包括用于访问它的API呼叫或者存储它的正确寄存器. 例外是秘密的API密钥,这些密钥不应该被共享,也不应被硬编码成复制脚本. 代码确实需要说明 API 键的位置 。

blocks.en: For better readability, we encourage researchers to thoroughly and clearly annotate the code they share. This means describing the overall goal of the script, the libraries and their versions, the functions and each of their components, and the steps the script executes. When possible, objects should follow a consistent and intuitive naming convention; the script should signpost final outputs and include relevant information about the computational resources used and run time. Finally, a self-contained workflow should also include a README file with the order of execution and other relevant information that will make our material easier to access and replicate.
blocks.zh: 为了更好的可读性,我们鼓励研究人员彻底和明确地说明他们共同使用的代码。 这意味着描述脚本的总体目标,库及其版本,功能及其每个组件,以及脚本执行的步骤. 在可能情况下,物体应遵循一致和直观的命名惯例;脚本应标出最后产出,并包括有关所用计算资源和运行时间的相关信息。 最后,自成一体的工作流程还应包括一个包含执行顺序的README文件和其他相关信息,这将使我们的材料更容易访问和复制.

blocks.en: Prompts
blocks.zh: 提示

blocks.en: In earlier chapters we have discussed and tested how varying prompt structure can influence output. In Section 5.3, we presented a recommended template for researchers to apply in their prompting tasks. We believe that using a template can help standardize reporting practices. While it is unrealistic to ask researchers to report all attempted prompts, researchers should report how they arrived at the final prompt, what aspects of the prompt were changed throughout testing, 30 30 30 Examples are the roles defined for the LLM, the order of categories, the examples used, etc. If the researcher systematically evaluated different prompt variants, then these should be reported as well. and how those changes affected the final output. The prompt should detail the structure of the responses requested, such as ‘respond with either 0 or 1’, ‘respond in one sentence’, ‘provide a summary no longer than 300 words’, or ‘provide the reasoning behind your answer’. While none of these reporting recommendations prevent prompt-hacking, they provide useful information for future researchers looking to replicate work and planning their own research.
blocks.zh: 在前几章中,我们讨论并测试了不同迅速结构如何影响产出。 在第5.3节中,我们提出了一个推荐的模板,供研究人员在启动任务时应用。 我们认为,使用一个模板有助于使报告做法标准化。 虽然要求研究人员报告所有尝试的提示是不切实际的,但研究人员应该报告他们是如何到达最后提示的,在整个测试过程中,提示的哪些方面被改变,30,30个实例是定义LLM的作用,类别顺序,使用的例子等. 如果研究人员系统地评估不同的即时变体,那么这些变体也应当报告。 以及这些变化如何影响最后产出。 该提示应详细说明所要求答复的结构,例如 " 对应于0或1 " 、 " 对应于一句话 " 、 " 提供不超过300字的概要 " 或 " 提供你的答复背后的理由 " 。 虽然这些报告建议中没有任何一项能够防止即时抄袭,但它们为希望复制工作和规划自己研究的未来研究人员提供了有用的信息。

blocks.en: Codebooks
blocks.zh: 代码本

blocks.en: Researchers need at least an expert-coded training or validation set to deploy any LLM. Annotation and validation quality relies on the quality of our training and validation sets. The codebooks used to produce these labels must be released, and researchers should document the instructions provided to coders. Any changes to the codebook should also be reported, as well as any lessons learned from the labeling task. 31 31 31 Labeling data is an iterative process that often requires multiple rounds of training and adjusting definitions. While the discipline values deductive approaches to labeling data (i.e., first we define the concept and then we identify it in the data), it is not uncommon to find variation of the concept or different categories altogether as we carry out this exercise inductively. We encourage researchers to report this as well. This reporting exercise serves many purposes. For one, it provides a benchmark for what we expect to capture in our task, allowing us to determine whether human and LLM labels capture concepts accurately. It also enriches the discipline, as codebooks and the processes to develop them are rarely reported, which deprives other researchers of valuable insights and lessons. Finally, codebook instructions are rarely copied verbatim into prompts. Releasing both lets readers see the choices made in translating instructions written for human coders into text built for the LLM.
blocks.zh: 研究人员至少需要一套专家编码的培训或鉴定装置来部署任何LLM。 注释和鉴定质量取决于我们培训和鉴定组的质量。 用于制作这些标签的代码表必须发布,研究人员应当将提供给代码员的指令记录下来. 还应报告代码手册的任何改动,以及从标签工作中吸取的任何教训。 31 31 标签数据是一个迭代过程,往往需要多轮培训和调整定义。 虽然学科对给数据贴标签的方法进行扣减(即,首先我们界定概念,然后在数据中加以识别),但当我们以推论方式开展这项工作时,找到概念或不同类别的整体变化并不罕见。 我们鼓励研究人员也报告这一情况。 这一报告工作有许多目的。 首先,它提供了我们期望在任务中捕捉到的东西的基准,使我们能够确定人类和LLM标签是否准确捕捉到概念. 它还丰富了学科,因为很少报告代码本和开发过程,这剥夺了其他研究人员的宝贵见解和教训. 最后,密码簿指示很少被逐字记录成提示。 两者都让读者看到在将为人类编码者编写的指令翻译为为LLM所建的文本时所作的选择.

blocks.en: Training sets and validation sets
blocks.zh: 成套培训和鉴定

blocks.en: In the social sciences, we pride ourselves on meticulous and theory-driven approaches to operationalize concepts. In our experience, the discipline is still a long way from meeting the standards it has largely agreed to. Training and validation sets must clearly identify two elements, the text to classify and its label. 32 32 32 The process to obtain test, training, and validation sets is the same. Our recommendations apply to all three. Additionally, training sets must be accompanied by documentation naming the column that carries the concept and defining every label value. Thus, if we were to classify a text as either positive (1), neutral (0), or negative (-1), it should be clear to other users what each number in the classification column means. If the training set requires merges to be usable, for example when the text lives in a separate file, then matching IDs and the merge code must be provided. Beyond transparency, clearly and cleanly reported training sets are a public good that could eventually allow for the creation of disciplinary benchmarks for what good performance means on the tasks we care about.
blocks.zh: 在社会科学方面,我们以细致和理论驱动的方法来实施概念为傲。 根据我们的经验,该纪律仍然远远没有达到它基本上同意的标准。 培训与审定组必须明确确定两个要素,即分类文本及其标签。 32 32 获得测试、培训和审定组的过程相同。 我们的建议适用于所有三个。 此外,培训集必须附有文件,标明带有该概念的栏目,并确定每个标签值。 因此,如果我们要将一个文本分为正数(1)、中数(0)或负数(-1),其他用户就应该清楚分类栏中每个数字的含义。 如果训练集要求合并可以使用,例如当文本生活在单独的文件中时,则必须提供匹配的ID和合并代码. 除了透明度之外,明确和清洁地报告的成套培训是一项公益,最终可以允许制定纪律基准,说明我们所关心任务的良好业绩意味着什么。

blocks.en: Training data
blocks.zh: 培训数据

blocks.en: Chapters 3 and 4 showed that we can further adapt encoder and decoder LLMs to specific domains. Encoders can be further trained using raw, unstructured text data. If permissions allow, we encourage researchers to make training data available to the public, including metadata like its source, the time frame it covers, and a snippet of the data. When providing access to the data, lightweight formats such as .txt are preferable, and it is always good practice to provide the code if the data requires merging or parsing. For decoders, on the other hand, we can adapt them with instruction-style prompt–response pairs, or with the ranked preference data used in RLHF. Further pre-training carries prohibitive costs, so efforts focus on these two post-training steps. In this book, QLoRA fine-tuning is exactly such supervised adaptation, and its training pairs deserve the same disclosure. For ranked question-answer pairs, in addition to the source and date, researchers should provide an explanation of how the questions and answers were matched, how the rankings were done, and the code used to structure the raw data.
blocks.zh: 第3章和第4章表明,我们可以进一步调整编码器和解码器LLMs以适应特定域. 编码器可以使用原始的,无结构的文本数据进一步训练. 如果许可允许,我们鼓励研究人员向公众提供培训数据,包括其来源、涵盖的时间框架和数据片段。 在提供数据访问时,更可取的是.txt等轻量级格式,如果数据需要合并或解析,提供代码总是良好做法. 另一方面,对于解码器,我们可以使用指令式的即时响应对,或者使用RLHF中使用的排序偏好数据来调整它们. 进一步的培训前费用令人望而却步,因此努力的重点是这两个培训后步骤。 在本书中,QLORA的微调正是这种有监督的适应,其训练对子也值得同样的披露. 对于排名的问答对联,除来源和日期外,研究者应解释问答如何匹配,排名如何进行,原始数据的结构使用代码.

blocks.en: Trained models
blocks.zh: 训练型号

blocks.en: In the making of this book, we ran more than 1,500 models and fine-tuned over 1,200. Not all the models can be made available at Hugging Face’s model repository, but researchers should publish the final versions of their models on the site. Transparency, we believe, means providing not only the complete workflow, but also the results of the intermediate steps. Researchers often share the code to fine-tune a model, but they should also share the final model used in their analysis. First, this allows other researchers to directly compare output when either fine-tuning the model again or deploying it, which is fundamental for replicability. Second, it becomes a public good whose generalizability other researchers can test by deploying it on new corpora. For models to be useful to other users, researchers need to include complete model cards, all the information we outline in this section, and clearly marked labels that match the output of the models. Note that this can, and should, be done for encoder and decoder models.
blocks.zh: 在这本书的制作过程中,我们运行了1500多个模型,并对1200多个模型进行了微调. 并非所有的模型都可以在Hugging Face的模型寄存处提供,但研究人员应该在网站上公布其模型的最终版本. 我们认为,透明度意味着不仅提供完整的工作流程,而且提供中间步骤的结果。 研究人员经常共享代码来微调一个模型,但他们也应该共享分析中使用的最终模型. 首先,这允许其他研究者在对模型再次进行微调或部署时直接比较输出,这对于可复制性至关重要. 其次,它成为公益物,其他研究者可以通过将其部署在新公司来测试其普遍性。 为了使模型对其他用户有用,研究者需要包括完整的模型卡,我们在本节中概述的所有信息,以及与模型输出相符的明显标记标签. 请注意,对于编码器和解码器模型,可以而且应该这样做。

blocks.en: We have provided a guide to transparency and tried to follow it in the development of this book. The repository accompanying this book contains the code, prompts, training data, and models behind every result (see https://github.com/llms-political-social-science-book-oup/book-code-data ). Transparency is what makes the rest of this chapter possible. Readers can only test replicability, reproducibility, and robustness against what authors disclose.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了透明度指南,并试图在这本书的编写过程中遵循这一指南。 本书所附的文献库载有每个结果背后的代码、提示、培训数据和模型(见https://github.com/llms-political-social-science-book-oup/book-code-data)。 透明度是本章其余部分得以实现的原因。 读者只能测试可复制性、可复制性和强健性,以对抗作者披露的内容。

blocks.en: 5.8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.8 结论

blocks.en: This chapter took the reproducibility and transparency debate on its own terms and attempted to give it a constructive turn. We believe the stochastic nature of LLMs does not mean that LLM research is not replicable, reproducible or robust. We proposed a general switch to probabilistic RT, which requires moving away from determinism into the analysis of distributions of results. We showed that the familiar tools of the discipline, from repeated cross-validation to disclosure norms, extend naturally to it. For the robustness of results across different LLMs, we argued that what matters is where models differ, and that the error-structure analysis tells researchers when the best model suffices and when an LLM ensemble approach is necessary. For downstream inference, DSL guarantees validity but can lower precision, and we proposed an ensemble approach that yields narrower and valid CIs. Transparency, finally, is what makes everything testable, and we have tried to hold this book to the standard it proposes. The deeper lesson runs through every section: the age of decoder LLMs has not abolished labeled data, but rather transformed the need for human-coded labels. It has changed the gold sample’s job, from fine-tuning the model to validating inference. A strong training and validation set is still one of the best investments an applied researcher can make.
blocks.zh: 本章就其本身的条件进行了可复制性和透明度的辩论,并试图给予它建设性的转变。 我们认为,LLMs的造型性并不意味着LLM研究是不可复制的、可复制的或强有力的。 我们建议全面改用概率性RT,这就要求从确定性转向分析结果的分布。 我们显示,该学科的熟悉工具,从反复交叉验证到披露规范,自然延伸至它。 对于不同LLMs中结果的强性,我们提出,重要的是模型的不同之处,错误结构分析告诉研究人员,何时最佳模型就足够了,何时需要LLM组合方法。 对于下游推论,DSL保证有效性,但可以降低精度,我们提出了一种能产生更窄有效的CI的综艺方法. 最后,透明度是一切可以检验的原因,我们努力使这本书达到它所建议的标准。 更深的教训贯穿每个部分:解码器LLMS的时代并没有废除标签数据,而是改变了对人码标签的需求. 这改变了黄金样本的工作,从调整模型到验证推论。 强大的培训和验证机制仍然是应用研究人员所能作出的最佳投资之一。
